A young girl who had never even been in a real fight.

One was a rookie who hadn’t even completed a double kill in the game…

Fate showed its grim face to the two young people and once again viciously shattered it just as their hopes were rising.

The two looked at each other, and what was revealed in their eyes was deep despair.

The ignorant were fearless; just as they were able to try to get the driver to stop or reach the end of the line without knowing there was a bomb in the bus, once they knew the bus was going to explode, their immediate reaction was to run away from the bus.

Similarly, when they didn’t know what the explosives were, they were able to take the chance that if the explosives in the bus were timed bombs, they could try to get everyone out of the bus first and then have the police sort it out, which was one of the plans Bespectacled Boy was going to write in his notebook at the time.

But now that the bus proved to have a bomb that could be detonated at any time, all plans were meaningless.

They were in the same time and space as the criminal, and what they could improvise, the other side could also improvise. Since that person had the idea of dying together sooner or later, the bomb would blow up sooner or later.

So if they wanted to stop this tragedy from happening, they would have to be more useful and stealthy.

What was that man after, exactly?

Li Shiqing scribbled in her notebook, “If that man was in the bus, he would have died too!”

Could there be a misanthropic complex?

Bespectacled Boy, who remained upbeat even in the face of such things, naturally could not understand how some people think or want to take revenge on society for some injustice they have suffered.

You can’t drag a bunch of innocent people into this! You can’t drag a bunch of innocent people into this!

Li Shiqing wrote with a force that penetrated the paper, shivering with anger.

“None of this is the point ……”

Bespectacled Boy looked out of the bus, and his expression suddenly became very complicated.

He blinked hard.

“… We really seem to be able to get off the station properly?”

Following his surprised gaze, Li Shiqing looked up in surprise to see the bus slowly approaching the bus stop on East River Road.

This was the last stop before going onto the bridge and the longest stop between the two stops on this bus route.

She used to see people accidentally riding past this stop and then begging the driver in various ways to pull over and let them turn back.

If you missed this stop, you would have to go to the bridge, and it took more than 20 minutes to get to the next stop, and counting the time to turn around and come back, you would be delayed by 40 to 50 minutes.

“Let’s shout for everyone to get off.”

Li Shiqing gritted her teeth and whispered to Bespectacled Boy, “Just shout that there’s a bomb in the bus, and run as fast as you can!”

“And then what? The same as I just did when I shouted the bus blew up, and even innocent passers-by had to die in vain?”

Bespectacled Boy shook his head, calmly extinguishing the last vestiges of Li Shiqing’s luck.

“Since we can get off the station normally, of course let’s get off first. Do you want to get blown up again?”

Li Shiqing shivered at the thought of the tearing pain she had felt several times before and couldn’t help but agree.

“OK, get off!”

They made their decision just as the bus automatically started to announce its stop.

[Link Seng Group reminds you that the East River Road station is here; please use the back door if you need to get off at the station.

“Go!”

Bespectacled Boy stood up first and gestured for Li Shiqing to wait with him at the back door.

The vast majority of people who took this route did so to cross the bridge, and there were no residential areas nearby, so they were the only two people who got off at this stop.

Li Shiqing’s and Xiao Heyun’s palms were sweating as they pressed the button to get off the bus and waited for the door to open.

Before they entered the “time loop,” they were both half asleep and had no memory of this stop, let alone getting off here.

Now they wanted to get out of the bus, but what if the madman in the bus didn’t give a damn about getting out of the bus?

What if he found out that someone was getting out of the bus and the bus just exploded?

It was the fear of the unknown that was most frightening, and in this the human imagination trumped even explosives.

With such fear, the bus, which they had just found “cozy,” seemed to have become some kind of eerie place, with only the railing by the door to lean on to give them a little courage to stand still.

The passengers on the bus, who were not at all visible, seemed to be able to unveil their own faces at any moment, revealing a frenzied and hideous face, so that they did not even have the courage to take the opportunity to look at them, lest the slightest flaw might provoke the man into another “death.”

Fortunately, it didn’t take long to get them to ramble on. The bus stopped slightly, and the back door opened without a moment’s delay, nor did anyone give them more than a passing glance.

Getting off at the station would have been the natural thing to do.

Li Shiqing and Bespectacled Boy were almost impatient to get out of the bus and jumped out.

As soon as she got off the bus, Li Shiqing went around to the back of the bus, took a picture of the number plate, and dialed 110.

“Hello, I’m calling the police. There’s a bomb on Bus 45 at East River Road station that’s heading to Jiangbei station. It’s just leaving East River Road station now. The license plate number is…”

It was the first time Bespectacled Boy had ever gotten out of the bus properly, and he was still observing his surroundings when he suddenly heard Li Shiqing behind him saying something.

However, Li Shiqing just gave him a somewhat puzzled look and went on to finish with a flourish.

“The explosives are not timed devices and could go off at any time, but the expected time of explosion is at 1:45 p.m. at the River Road crossroads or on the Cross River Bridge. Also, the person who planted the bomb is in the bus, so please be very careful!”

Unlike SMS alerts, it was significantly easier to say something over the phone, and inquiries from the other party came much quicker.

“Gee, you don’t know how I know. Time is of the essence. Can you guys go and sort out the bomb thing first?”

When Li Shiqing saw that the police officer had started asking the same series of questions as last time, she was so anxious that she was about to explode. “What do you mean, what are our demands? What can I ask? My request is that you stop this bus from exploding!”

“That’s all I can reveal; I don’t know anything else!”

Seeing that she was about to get stuck in an endless loop of “Why do you know what you know?” she simply hung up the phone.

“Do you have any idea what you’re doing?”

Xiao Heyun held back his anger until she hung up the phone.

“I’m calling the police, aren’t I? I didn’t even finish reporting it last time ……”

Li Shiqing mumbled as she looked at Bespectacled Boy, who was grimacing in front of her.

“And you say you don’t want to be interrogated by the police anymore; isn’t that just another way to get us in that hole?”

Bespectacled Boy was exasperated. “We just got out of the bus. Why did you call the police?”

“But we must still be summoned to …… as soon as we get off the bus.”

Li Shiqing was in the middle of her sentence when she suddenly reacted and stopped for a moment.

Twice before, they had gotten out of the bus suddenly halfway through the day, and the timing was so coincidental that it would have been unconscionable for the police not to suspect them.

Even if they were questioned by the police, all they had to do was explain that they were “getting off at the station.”

Even if the bus did explode, they, as two “survivors,” would only be consoled and be grateful that no one would ever be happy that they survived.

“But that bus will explode!”

With no one at the bus stop, Li Shiqing has no qualms about voicing her thoughts.

“That’s a busload of people! We can get off the bus ourselves because we’re escaping the pain of death, but we can’t watch them in trouble and do nothing; that’s a straw man!”

Her emotions were still lingering from the regret that in the last time cycle she had not succeeded in alerting the police, let alone solving any problems.

“And have you ever wondered if ‘getting off normally’ is also a possibility for stopping the time loop?”

Bespectacled Boy suddenly sneered.

“What if this stop is the way of life that God has purposely set aside for us?”

“Have you always been so impulsive in what you do? Before too, not planning well and having to listen to you all the time, what can be the result? Call the police, and the police will believe you?”

“How do you know we’re bound to cycle through time again? Is it okay to mess around when the lives and deaths of so many people are at stake?”

“How do you know that there won’t be a limit to the number of time cycles? If you don’t treat every time loop as if it’s the last, what if it really is just the last one? Continue to be held as a suspect until you die?”

Bespectacled Boy continuously questioned Li Shiqing.

Unlike Li Shiqing, who cries when she breaks down and speaks up when she wants to give up, Xiao Heyun was an adult who wanted to be more reliable and take care of Li Shiqing, so he was very restrained in his emotions so that they would get along, and tried to be more humble to Li Shiqing.

But that didn’t mean he was really a noodle man.

The negative emotions he had been holding in his heart had been accumulating, and although he was doing his best to manage his emotions well, now that he had easily encountered a glimmer of hope, only to have it extinguished once again, the psychological fallout from this could not be described in words at all.

Now he was on the verge of exploding with emotion just like that bus.

Li Shiqing’s face grew whiter and whiter as Xiao Heyun questioned her, and reason made her realize that he was right, and she even felt a hint of regret at the bottom of her heart…

“And then what? Just watch them die because of that?”

And yet, deep down, there was still something that made her reluctant to “live with it.”

“Even if this really is the last cycle of the time loop, even if you escape the loop, when you remember the past, won’t you feel guilty and remorseful when you think of what you could have done but didn’t?”

“There’s always a way!”

She said it as if she had convinced Bespectacled Boy, or herself.

“Surely there can be a better way! We have to try!”

During the argument, Li Shiqing’s mobile phone rang again, presumably a call back from the police trying to verify the information, but as no one bothered to answer it, the ringing could only be repeated on a loop.

This made the two feel more and more irritated.

“You turn your phone off first, unless you still want to go to the police station!”

Bespectacled Boy restrained himself from being on the verge of an outburst and decided to get over this hurdle before talking about the future.

“Forget it; it’s done, and no bickering is going to help.”

Faced with this passive situation, he wiped his face tiredly, and his mind was in turmoil, unable to piece together any better solution.

He refused to acknowledge that Li Shiqing’s “unrepentant” attitude had moved him, but once again he chose to “give in” to Li Shiqing.

“Let’s find a place to hide, and then we’ll talk it over!”

The author has something to say:  No matter how well Bespectacled Boy and Li Shiqing understand each other, they were just strangers who didn’t know each other before, and they have been able to get along with each other until now because of the “pressure of life and death”. Fortunately, Bespectacled Boy is a much calmer and more considerate a person than the hot-headed Li Shiqing, and is able to deal with these conflicts between them.

CONTENT END 15

chapters.title: The Eleventh Time Cycle (II)
chapters.content:
Bespectacled Boy was an outsider and was not familiar with the area, but Li Shiqing remembered that there was a large park nearby and that there was less surveillance in the outskirts, so they decided to hide there first and then see what they could do.

Because of Bespectacled Boy’s rare outburst of anger, Li Shiqing wilted a little on the way and did not initiate any further mention of the bus, but her mind was still on whether the bus could be saved.

As Bespectacled Boy stated, she had died so many times that she had become “numb” to it and had grown accustomed to this “time loop,” subconsciously believing that it was a natural thing to keep “coming back from the dead.” In her mind, she felt that it was normal to keep coming back from the dead, without considering what would happen if the cycling of time stopped or if it could not be repeated.

Unlike Xiao Heyun, who hadn’t had to time loop many times, the few times he had experienced a time loop, he had had the companionship of “Li Shiqing” to lean on, and the despair of watching people die and not being able to solve it in any way hadn’t quite gotten to him.

He was more inclined to “break out of this time loop myself” than to “save the whole bus.”

This difference in perception became more and more evident when the two finally began to ‘talk’ in a secluded place.

“The best thing that can happen now is that our time loop stops, and we can sleep and wake up tomorrow. Whether the bus is in trouble or not, it’s none of our business.”

Bespectacled Boy sighed wearily. “But if that’s the case, sooner or later we’ll face questions about how we knew the bomb was in the bus; after all, we can’t turn off our phones forever or hide forever.”

At that, Li Shiqing impulsively argued, “But if the police succeeded in solving this bus bombing case because I called the police, they would have figured out the cause of the explosion, what the explosives were, and the identity of the culprit. If they choose to inform the whole network as they did last time, we will be able to get these causes and clues ……”

“This scenario that you are talking about is the best possible outcome. Let’s not mention whether the police will be able to solve the case as soon as possible and whether they will notify all across the network; there is still a prerequisite for your matter to turn good…”

Bespectacled Boy smiled bitterly. “These clues will only be useful to us if we actually recycle time.”

But were they willing to enter the time loop again?

Such cruel words he didn’t say.

But as soon as Li Shiqing saw his expression, she understood.

So she became more and more silent.

“There is also the possibility that the police have not solved the case and the time loop has continued again….”

Bespectacled Boy rubbed the bridge of his nose, which was pressed against by the nose pads, and said feebly, “Then there’s no point in getting off at this stop, except to be on tenterhooks, and all this time is tantamount to being wasted.”

“I thought you got out of the bus just because you didn’t want to get blown up again, plus I was pretty abused by that near-death feeling, so I chose to get out of the bus and call the police, but that doesn’t mean I don’t want to get involved in this.”

Li Shiqing had never discovered the real disagreement between her and her companion until this moment: “If I hadn’t called the police, what were you going to do when you got out of the bus if you weren’t trying to find clues?”

“Do nothing.”

Bespectacled Boy shrugged his shoulders.

“My original plan was to get off the bus first and then use the normal excuse of ‘getting off at the station’ to get past the police after being summoned. If this goes away and there is no time loop later on, the matter will have nothing to do with us.”

He said, “I know you probably think I’m too ‘scrupulous,’ but as you can see, with a bomb in the bus and an unknown number of terrorists, this kind of thing is simply not even for ordinary people like us to tackle. We’ve died so many times, and we’ve done our best!”

“If all of us in this bus are destined to die, then it is possible that we escaped because Heaven opened their eyes, or it is possible that King Yama took a nap; either way, one must cherish the opportunity. We are not the true culprits; we do not need to feel guilty for not being able to save everyone…”

“But I harbor a guilty conscience towards you.”

Li Shiqing suddenly interrupted his eloquent speech.

“I’m afraid to even pull anyone off the bus anymore because of the guilt I feel towards you.”

Bespectacled Boy’s face, which had been full of concern, gave a lurch.

In the wetland park, it was so quiet that even the chirping of insects and birds could be heard clearly.

A flock of skimming birds passed over their heads, sending a faint chirp from high above, the sky far and the clouds wide, setting off the girl’s ever-smaller voice, yet her voice was so clear and strong.

“Although you never complained to me, I’ve always felt guilty,” she said. “I pulled you down regardless to escape that suffocating place, and although you said I saved your life in a sense, and I thought so at the time, it’s been a dozen times now, and I know… This kind of ‘living’ is worse than death.”

“You ……”

Bespectacled Boy looked at the girl and could not open his mouth for half a day.

“I’m the one who brought you into this hell. Yes, the lives of all the people on this bus may not have anything to do with me, but your life now does.”

She still held herself together with a “strong” attitude, as she had done countless times when she was on the verge of breaking down and regaining her strength.

“I wanted to give up once too, when you said to me, ‘Think about your parents…'”

She looked at Bespectacled Boy, at every detail of his face, as if trying to memorize him in this way.

“I’m not thinking about my parents; I’m thinking about your parents.”

“My parents were so upset to know that something might have happened to me that they wanted to jump off a building, and my dad got the call and went on the highway. My mom said that nothing was as important as my life. So what kind of pain would your parents be in if they knew I had put their son through this?”

“These are sins, which I have committed.”

With such words ringing in his ears and being looked at in such a way, Bespectacled Boy ducked his head half in shyness and half in dismay.

“I understood everything you said, all the expectations you had, all the possibilities you tried, and all the attempts you made to get off the bus and return to your normal life. I tried too. That moment when I dragged you off the bus, I thought, as you did, that maybe it would be the last time, but as it turned out, heaven just wouldn’t let me go.”

Her eyes slowly flooded with an orb of tears, and when they were full, they flowed down her cheeks and silently traced their way across her chin to the floor.

“I know what it’s like to keep coming back, and I know how desperate it is to struggle alone and not see results. I’ve ‘died’ five more times than you have. If the time loop had a countdown, I might disappear before you do, so I have to try more possibilities before I do.”

“I know you’re bullied, and you don’t want to bully anyone…,” she choked out but tried hard to smile. “I, I understand all that.”

Xiao Heyun sat on the bench, looking at the little girl in front of him, smiling while she was in tears, as if she had been struck by an electric shock and all her limbs had become sore.

What followed was an unspeakable shame that filled the heart.

Yes, his lofty words, his feigned adult maturity, his condescending explanations as if he deserved them…

It was all just a cover for his “fear.”

“So, I can’t force you to keep trying; you can leave.”

Li Shiqing pointed to the road not far away and continued, “If the police do find me, I won’t name you; I’ve been through two questionings, and I know what to say. You, on the other hand, are just a nice guy who saw that I wasn’t in the right spirit when I got out of the bus; you can stonewall the police and go about your day.”

“I’ve thought about it when I was just walking over here: if we can get off at the East River Road stop every time, even though we can’t escape the time loop and get on every time, you can still get off at the stop.”

“That way, at least … at least you won’t feel the pain of death every time. I’ll stay in the bus and keep looking for the real killer, find a way to stop the bus from exploding, find a way to get the police to catch the killer, and you can just go and do whatever you want when you get out of the bus and get away from all this pain …”

When she spoke of the separation, she did not look sad, as if she was truly “relieved” to have escaped the pain of her companion in this way, and her tone even became lighter.

“I’ve seen quite a few sci-fi movies like that, and the protagonist in those movies ended up with a successful outcome. Some of those protagonists were in the same daylong loop, boring and painful, but they used that time to teach themselves piano, to teach themselves dance, to teach themselves many, many useful things, and every day was different for them; some used that time to make up for their regrets, to do things they were afraid to do… By the time they finally broke free of the time loop, they all became very good people.”

She said, “I think that the length of time may not be sufficient, but as long as the width is enough, it shouldn’t be too bad a life.”

Xiao Heyun pursed his lips, his breath coming in long and short bursts, his chest rising and falling in response. He had avoided Li Shiqing’s too-clear gaze, but now he couldn’t look away.

The naivety in this girl that he had previously “criticized” was now so thrilling.

That innocence was her weapon and her armor, which crushed Xiao Heyun.

“I’ll try. I’ll try to find the real killer, try to assist the police, and try to break us out of this time loop. You don’t have to worry about me or feel obliged to stay and help me because you’re morally bound; just pretend you don’t know me and get off where you’re supposed to….”

“Because this whole thing had nothing to do with you in the first place, it was something I should have faced alone.”

The tears on Li Shiqing’s face had gradually dried with the wind, and there was no sign that she had even cried. It was shameful to say so much from her heart in front of someone she didn’t know very well, so every now and then a shy expression would show on her face.

But she was brave enough to say it anyway.

“Stolen time is time too; you can live your life, go do what you want to do, and don’t give up. Maybe, like those movies, suddenly one day I make it, or the old heavens open up, and you’re no longer in a time loop…”

She gave a touching smile.

“I hope that by that time you have turned out to be as good as those main characters.”

Bespectacled Boy looked at her steadily and did not speak.

“So, it’s time to see you off again then?”

Probably because she thought she had confused Bespectacled Boy, she rubbed her nose in embarrassment and held out her right hand to him.

“Good luck, and good luck to me.”

CONTENT END 16

chapters.title: The Eleventh Cycle of Time (III)
chapters.content:
When Li Shiqing first started university, her mother was worried about her falling in love at an early age, and she spent an agonizing night of advice with her.

Li Shiqing had forgotten most of what she said that night, except for a few words that she had always remembered.

Mom said, “You can’t force a relationship between people. When the other person is no longer in love, you don’t have to force it; it’s good to get together and leave yourself some last respect. The most important quality for a woman is self-respect.”

She said, “You can’t think that just because the other person is a man that they should give in to you and cooperate with you in everything, because what you don’t want to do, what you don’t want to happen, they don’t want to do either. If you get used to being dependent, you lose the ability to stand on your own two feet, and that’s putting all the chips in someone else’s hands who can shuffle the deck and start over at any time.”

She added, “A good relationship is one where both people are getting better from it, and if you find that one person is suffering or one person is getting worse, then there is something wrong with the relationship and you need to reflect on it. If it’s not your problem, then it’s time to end the relationship. If the problem is not solved, time will bring it to an end even if you don’t want it to.”

Although her mother was talking about how one should respect and love oneself in a relationship with a man, Li Shiqing always felt that her mother’s words were just as true when placed in the context of normal human interaction.

After all, relationships are a form of “human interaction.”

So, even if they were just ordinary friends, Li Shiqing had always followed this guideline to get along with them.

She was not “retreating” or “posturing”; she was extending her hand to Bespectacled Boy, not as an invitation but as a promise.

Her “goodbye” was a wish that he would “never see it again.”

“If I let go and leave now, then I won’t be a ‘very good’ person in my life.”

A pair of large, warm, dry palms came up and took her hand gently in theirs.

The coldness of Li Shiqing’s fingers softened his heart.

Her heart might not have been as dashing as it appeared to be, or perhaps she was just holding back the fear and reluctance in her heart, but she still wanted to set him free with the utmost goodwill.

“I’m not going to run.”

He used to wonder why such an ordinary girl would encounter such strange things.

Now he knew.

–Because she was such a good girl, even heaven couldn’t bear to let her go like that and wanted to give her a chance to live.

And because she was such a good girl, heaven couldn’t even bear to let her “go at it alone,” living in such a cruel world.

At least for now, his thoughts were in agreement with that master in the underworld.

“You don’t have to…”

Li Shiqing was worried that he could not save face because of his moral conflicts and tried to persuade him again.

“I understand what you’re saying, but my pride won’t allow me to do this ‘hide behind someone else and enjoy the fruits of their labor with peace of mind’ thing. Just think of it as looking after my ego, okay?”

Bespectacled Boy’s previous impatience and anger had now subsided, and he had returned to the calmness and goodwill he had when he first met Li Shiqing.

How could he be more cowardly than a little girl?

Bespectacled Boy even joked with her. “If I feel like I can’t hold on anymore, I’ll tell you to give me a ‘half day off’ and let me get off and go on a flurry, okay?”

“Yes! OK! No problem! It’s okay if you want to give it up! Thank you!”

That said, no one could have known that they would have to face this alone without fear, and the moment Bespectacled Boy smiled at her again, a glow of hope returned to Li Shiqing’s eyes.

“Thank you so much; you’re a great guy!”

Clearly capable of such a long speech just now, she could only express her surprise and gratitude in such dull language in the face of the kindness of others.

“Well, the two of us are still polite to each other. What, are we all in the same boat… er, a bus? Already beyond mere acquaintance kind of friendship, the next step is to help each other.”

After reaching some kind of “friendly agreement,” Bespectacled Boy looked in the direction of the bridge and said with some concern, “I don’t know what’s going on there now, and that’s not good. Without the bus, there’s so little information available.”

They arrived at the station and got off the bus at just after 13.20. Several of the bombings were at 13.45, which was why Li Shiqing specifically mentioned this time when she reported the incident.

But they both knew that the bomb could have been detonated at any time, and they did not know whether the police had succeeded in stopping it.

“At least there was no smoke in that direction, and there were no vibrations coming from it.”

Li Shiqing also looked up and gazed afar. “If it hits the tanker again, the sky will surely fall apart, right?”

“Let’s hope so.”

Having decided to ‘go with Li Shiqing,’ Bespectacled Boy didn’t mention anything about ‘just getting past the police and getting on with life’ but turned on his phone and searched the internet for news and information.

Li Shiqing’s mobile phone was switched off, and she was left sitting on the sidelines, nervously waiting for Bespectacled Boy to find out something.

“Look at this!”

After about twenty minutes or so, there was a news article on a local forum about a bus explosion.

It’s horrible! Two police cars just pulled over a bus on the River Road bridge, and we were watching and wondering what was going on when the bus blew up! Everyone on the bus was killed; it was so horrible!

Below this post, there is another piece of footage captured on a mobile phone.

In the picture, two police cars followed one after the other next to a bus, with police loudspeakers blaring the words “police inspection, pull over,” and the bus did follow the police car in front of it and slowly drove to the emergency lane on the bridge; many passing cars slowed down, obviously wanting to spectate.

But the moment a couple of policemen got on the bus, the bus suddenly exploded!

With a “Holy shit, there’s a bomb!” The camera shook violently, and the driver and the filmmaker in the passenger seat both ran out of the car in panic, ending the footage.

Hundreds of people left comments below, mostly questioning the authenticity of the footage, while others said it was a live clip from a film—a wide range of opinions that piqued everyone’s curiosity.

Naturally Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun saw the post, and by the time they had watched all the footage taken on their phones, both were as pale as if they had seen a ghost.

“Knowing there was a bomb, no, shouldn’t the road have been closed first…?”

Li Shiqing shivered and said.

“It’s too short a time to do that.”

Bespectacled Boy also clenched his fist and gritted his back teeth. “You called the police and said it in detail, but when you finished, you turned it off, and this kind of thing sounds so absurd; the police must have gone to find out what happened and make sure it wasn’t someone calling in a false alarm first…”

Even if someone from the nearest police agency were sent, there would only be enough time to find the exact bus. To evacuate people and control the roads would require the cooperation of several departments, not to mention the fact that “handling explosives” is something that can only be done by more specialized departments.

The post was quickly removed from the forum, and while people on the forum were debating whether the posts had been removed because they were “spreading false content,” someone pointed the way directly to Twitter and told everyone that the story was true.

With a heavy heart, Bespectacled Boy opened up Twitter again.

Although the post was deleted from the local forum, many media and self-publishers have already reposted the story, in addition to a number of people who were on the bridge at the time uploading videos recorded on their dashcam recorders or mobile phones.

There was no one who could be calm with these images.

The chaos and fear were like a plague that quickly infected all the buses and pedestrians present at the time. The video of people’s wailing screams and the roaring horns of vehicles accompanied by a background of rolling smoke was an apocalyptic scene.

And indeed, the scene of the accident was gut-wrenching enough.

A number of vehicles slammed on their brakes at the time of the explosion because of the violent noise, which caused a series of car accidents on the bridge, affecting dozens of oncoming vehicles and injuring many people.

A driver who thought he was in a “terrorist attack” and chose to turn around in the middle of the road regardless, only to cause an even bigger accident halfway down the road.

There were pedestrian walkways on both sides of the River Road Bridge, and the impact of the bus explosion sent explosives flying onto the walkways, unceremoniously slamming them into fleeing passers-by, who have now been taken to the hospital, leaving behind a trail of bloodstained glass and deformed, charred scrap metal.

“Oh my god…”

Li Shiqing looked at the riotous scenes in those images and drew in a breath of cold air.

Neither she nor Bespectacled Boy had ever seen the scene of a bus explosion before.

The first time she got off the bus that time, she got hit and went to the hospital, not knowing what the scene was like, although she saw a number of burn victims in the hospital.

Xiao Heyun was better and was burnt to death straight away.

After that their next disembarkation, they quickly moved away from the scene of the explosion, and that area of the road was immediately blocked off without causing any further disturbance.

On top of that, every time they had an accident, they were on the bus, “living and dying” with it, and as soon as their eyes opened and closed, they were in another time loop, completely unaware of what was going on behind them.

Bespectacled Boy pursed his lips and skillfully searched the internet for available information, but in the modern world, information was expanding at an explosive rate, and with this expansion comes a situation where it was difficult to select the factual and truthful content from the vast amount of information available.

With less than an hour to go, most of the media did not dare speculate until the results of the investigation were announced, and there was more than enough public opinion to express outrage at the tragedy, regret, and mourning for the innocent victims involved in the disaster, but not much usable information could be found beyond that.

Rather, there were one or two whispers that the police had forced the bus to stop because they had received a call claiming that there was a bomb in the bus and requesting an investigation.

However, before the police could verify the real situation, the bus exploded and killed a number of police officers who were in the bus to check it out.

But this kind of information was of no use to “parties” like them.

“You’re right; that’s what happens when you don’t have a plan.”

Li Shiqing trembled, her face full of remorse.

“I was in too much of a hurry; I should have looked for more clues…”

“You did what you had to do by remembering to inform the police in that situation.”

Bespectacled Boy reassured her without looking up and kept swiping through the local police interface.

“There was so little time, and it’s to be expected that a lot of things can’t be stopped.”

This explosion was unlike the previous ones, which were all collisions with tankers and left nothing at the scene. This explosion should have left a lot of clues and evidence, such as what the explosives were and where they were in the bus, and then, investigating the surveillance based on these clues, they should be able to find out who brought the explosives onto the bus.

But as Bespectacled Boy said, there was “too little time,” and she didn’t know if it was because the scene was crowded with relief efforts or because they couldn’t rush the case until there was a clear picture, but there were no clues to the real killer on the internet.

During this time, Li Shiqing and Bespectacled Boy shifted their location in the park several times, finally hiding near a rockery where few park goers approached.

At around 4 or 5pm, Bespectacled Boy also received a ‘summons’ call from the police but ignored it on the pretext that he ‘couldn’t make it’ and then ignored and hung up on all calls.

The two made up their minds to avoid the day and die without going to the police station.

As it got darker and darker, and the park was almost empty, the two had yet to find any useful clues on the internet, but the rumors of Li Shiqing’s phone call were getting more and more sinister.

Some say the 911 call was an internal disagreement within the terrorists, someone’s conscience; some say the caller was a self-directed acting personality; others say the caller was provoking the police in this way, like the big villain in some suspenseful movie or TV show who always left all kinds of clues…

“I’m famous now.”

Li Shiqing laughed to herself, “I never thought I’d turn into a ‘villain’ again.”

Bespectacled Boy’s phone was running out of battery, and instead of swiping it all the time like he did before, he now pulled it out every ten or twenty minutes to check for any new news.

“What’s wrong with you…?”

Li Shiqing saw Bespectacled Boy staring at the screen of his mobile phone, freezing for a long time, and stretched her head in wonder.

It was a local police bulletin that did not explain the circumstances of the explosion but merely announced the identities of the police officers who had died in the line of duty during the incident.

On the illuminated screen, it was the amiable-looking middle-aged police officer who appeared…

Mr. Zhang.

CONTENT END 17

chapters.title: The Twelfth Cycle of Time
chapters.content:
Both Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun had a good impression of this kind and generous “police uncle.”

Their experiences of ‘urgent questioning’ were difficult to recall, but they were not without their warmth.

Li Shiqing remembered the quilt he tucked in for her and the eyes that were red from the tragedy of the accident.

Xiao Heyun remembered him, remembering every glass of water he handed him, remembering him asking if he wanted to eat, remembering his “no matter how unbelievable it is, we will believe it.”

Although Mr. Zhang didn’t believe it in the end, he never resented the police, nor did he blame them for torturing people so much, because it was thanks to these respectable and fearful police officers that they were able to live in peace.

It would be disrespectful to the innocent victims if the suspects were not treated harshly.

But now, this honorable and dear officer was dead, killed in the bombing.

Because of their “indiscretion.”

“We’ll still time loop, won’t we?”

Li Shiqing’s heart became heavier and heavier after reading the life of Mr. Zhang.

“He’ll be alive and well when we cycle through time again, won’t he?”

Mr. Zhang was only forty-six years old, a veteran of more than twenty years in the criminal police force, having helped solve several major cases that have become a sensation throughout the province and the country.

The short briefing was full of appreciation and grief for this elite member of the police force.

“I don’t know.”

A gleam of bitterness flooded Bespectacled Boy’s lips. “But I wish I could time loop again.”

Their “efforts” did not stop the explosion but caused more casualties.

This was something neither he nor Li Shiqing wanted.

With such a ‘discovery,’ both Li Shiqing and Bespectacled Boy felt bad, and even when they looked for more information, they were depressed, with only sorrow and guilt filling their hearts.

As the screen went completely black, Bespectacled Boy reluctantly put the phone in his bag.

The wetland park was closed to the public at night, and it was already seven or eight o’clock in the evening. The two of them had been hiding on this rockery for hours, and no one had passed by. There were no lights, no food; it was dark in all directions, and their stomachs were rumbling, so they could only rely on small talk to overcome their loneliness and restlessness.

“Next time, get some food and water before you get off the bus.”

Bespectacled Boy rubbed his stomach. “You say it’s a strange thing; I didn’t feel hungry on the bus, and within a few hours of getting off it, I felt hungry.”

“How can we be hungry when we’ll only live a few minutes in the bus?”

Li Shiqing looked at the dark shadows in the distance and was a little frightened, so she unconsciously moved closer to Bespectacled Boy, but her mind was on other things.

“If we can get back to the bus, we must find the killer and also figure out what the explosives are before informing the police.”

“Hmm.”

Knowing that she was still blaming herself for the incident, Bespectacled Boy chimed in.

“When the police get on the bus, we have to assist them in controlling the culprit; otherwise, a busload of people will be in danger.”

She reminded Bespectacled Boy.

“Well, good.”

“We’ll have to remind them to get in plain clothes,” Li Shiqing thought of another point: “It’s best to remind them again to evacuate the crowd and block off traffic in advance.”

“Yes.”

Bespectacled Boy nodded along.

“What do we do if we do get back to the bus?”

Li Shiqing finally stopped saying “Do as I say” this time. “Aren’t you the best at making plans? Let’s make a plan.”

“First we have to line up who is suspicious in the bus.”

Bespectacled Boy said without thinking, “The bus was small and there weren’t many people in it, so if the perpetrator was able to set off the explosion very stealthily and immediately, that means that bomb would have been buried with him and we probably wouldn’t even have been able to observe how it was set off.”

“Check who’s busying bags or large luggage first?”

Li Shiqing was very clear.

“Yes. The first thing to look at is who’s carrying something, and the stupider way is to eliminate them one by one. The ones with bags on their backs, like me, and the ones with things under their feet—check to see if they’re carrying bombs.”

Bespectacled Boy sighed again when he thought about their “workload.”

“But if you do that, you’ll have to go directly up against the thugs; they may not give you a warning, and you may have to die straight away again…”

Who would show you if they’re really burying a bomb? It might detonate as soon as it’s discovered.

It might not even be necessary to find out, as long as the culprit was alerted to the fact that he had been spotted, he might be ready to “BOOM.”

“And people don’t always let you search; they might have to fight….”

Li Shiqing scratched her head. “How about we do it the stupid way? You overpower the owner of something by surprise, and I take the opportunity to open someone’s bag or luggage to check?”

“That’s the only way to go.”

Bespectacled Boy patted his chest and rightfully replied, “I’m at least a man, stronger than you. I can’t ask you to fight someone, can I?”

The two of them were just slowly refining possible plans in the darkness, you and me. Time passed by; so involved were they in their deliberations that they even forgot about their physical hunger and mental exhaustion.

But it wasn’t long before the unexpected struck.

“What’s that over there? Street lights on?”

Li Shiqing, with a sharp eye, pointed to a light source in the east and indicated to Bespectacled Boy to look.

They were now nestled on top of a rockery somewhere in the park, high enough up and next to a shelter so that anyone coming could see them at a glance, and they could hide inside the rockery for most of the day.

“It seemed to be the light of a torch, and there were quite a few of them.”

Bespectacled Boy narrowed his eyes and suddenly shuddered.

“No good, it’s the police looking for us!”

What else could it be, if not the police looking for someone with this kind of strong torch and so many at that?

“Here to see us? There’s no surveillance around here, so why…”

When Li Shiqing heard “police,” she swayed and subconsciously tried to get into the shelter.

“Who knows, maybe the location of the base station was located through a mobile phone signal, maybe someone saw it; it’s just us two ordinary people, isn’t it normal that we can’t hide from the police?”

Bespectacled Boy grabbed her hand tightly. “Don’t be afraid; your phone is off all the time. If they want to find it, they’ll be looking for me. I’ll go down first and try to see if I can lure them away. You hide here now. I’m going to fool around and come back for you in the morning…”

Seeing the light of the torch getting closer, he thought nothing of it, stood up, and ran from the shelter.

Before he could jump up and take two steps, he saw that he had tripped over something and fell down the rockery.

“Ugh!”

“Look out!”

Li Shiqing was quick to grab the clothes on his back, but she was too weak and was buried down the rockery with him.

“Ah!”

“What a guy!”

“Who’s that over there?”

With intense dizziness and pain coming from her head and golden lights popping up in front of her eyes, Li Shiqing vaguely felt a light shining on her face…

Someone came up to them, and she heard someone tsking at her.

“How can there be such dumb criminals?”

“You’re the one who’s stupid; your whole family is stupid!”

With a mental yell, she was so angry and in pain that she finally passed out.

—

Li Shiqing felt pain on her face and was once again sober on the bus.

She couldn’t have imagined that the two of them would return to the bus in such an “odd” way.

Not to mention the fact that one moment her “companion” was “bravely” saying he would help her distract the police, and the next, he was taking her straight to the pit.

“I’m highly myopic with astigmatism and a bit of night blindness…”

Bespectacled Boy scratched his head apologetically. “I’m sorry for getting you into trouble, but look, we’re back, aren’t we?”

“Do I care that you got me involved? What I care about is that we’re so fucking stupid to be found out!”

Li Shiqing lowered her voice to grumble.

The shame of being taunted on the ground still seemed to haunt her, and without looking, Li Shiqing knew soon enough how the police would be made aware if they didn’t “come back”.

[The suspects, so-and-so and so-and-so, lost their footing due to slippery feet and accidentally fell from the shelter where they were hiding and managed to fall into the police net].

What a “slippery foot” criminal!

“Ow!”

The more she thought about it, the more she regretted it and rubbed her face vigorously.

Probably embarrassed by the fact that one moment he was a “hero” and the next he was a “bear,” Bespectacled Boy coughed dryly, looked around, lowered his voice, and said to her.

“You let me go out for a walk, and I’ll go and observe which people have brought large luggage.”

When he got down to business, Li Shiqing’s expression, which had been tinged with a bit of shyness, suddenly straightened, and she immediately gave way to him.

They had returned earlier this time and were not yet at East River Road station, but given the short time between each stop, they would probably be at the next one soon.

Pretending to get up and move his arms and legs, Xiao Heyun shook his hands and stamped his feet, pacing the carriage.

He and Li Shiqing both boarded the bus in Jiangdong District, which was full of universities and high-tech companies, and there were quite a few people on board, which was why they had to sit together.

However, with a number of people getting on and off the bus along the way, a number of people on the bus got off in the commercial centre area of Jiangdong District, and later on there were even fewer people getting on and more people getting off, and when there were more empty seats, many people did not want to sit with others, so the passengers in the bus were now scattered in various locations on this bus.

If Li Shiqing hadn’t been sleeping, she would have found an empty seat halfway through.

From the front to the back, Bespectacled Boy mentally counted the number of people. Excluding the driver, him, and Li Shiqing, there were only nine people, four in the front and middle area and the rest in the back of the bus, very spread out.

He wandered past every seat pretending to loiter, noticing that more or less everyone in the carriage was busy with something, but only three people were busy with conspicuous luggage.

One was an old grandfather sitting in front of the back door, with a short stick in his hand and two snakeskin bags at his feet. The bags were bulging, and it was impossible to see what was inside, but you could tell from what you saw that there was a lot of stuff inside.

One was a middle-aged man sitting in the middle seat in the back row, a man with dark skin and a sturdy build, with the kind of toughness in his demeanor that was characteristic of manual workers. On the seat next to him was the usual cylindrical gym bag, but the satchel was slightly worn and bulging in size.

He hadn’t been sleeping or looking at his phone, but it was obvious that he was lost in thought.

Bespectacled Boy remembered him from the previous times he had been subdued by passengers on the bus, and each time, the middle-aged man had been the “main man,” easily beating him down as a strong young man.

He even remembered the pain of the man using those powerful arms to hold him down in a death grip.

The third, an older woman in a flowery shirt, was sitting in the front row across the aisle from them.

The older woman looked to be in her mid-forties, thin and ordinary-looking, like the kind of housewife you often see.

As with most housewives out and about for the same reason, she had a large plastic bag of the supermarket variety at her feet and appeared to have just returned from a major purchase.

But because she was sitting on the outside, with the plastic bag on the floor inside, and the older woman’s legs blocking Bespectacled Boy’s view, it was impossible to see what was inside that plastic bag.

It was this older woman who said she had to go home to cook for her family and could not afford to delay giving evidence to Li Shiqing.

As Xiao Heyun was so gentle-looking and fair-skinned, not many people expressed their impatience with him walking around, and some even asked him nicely if he was looking for a place to get off and could help tell him.

While Bespectacled Boy was scouting the bus, Li Shiqing was also looking carefully at everyone’s position, trying to remember which direction each blast had come from.

Soon the familiar announcement of the stop sounded again, and the bus slowly pulled up to the Bus 45 stop and opened its doors.

This time, no one got out of the bus, but someone got in through the front door.

Xiao Heyun, who was skulking around the bus carriage, and Li Shiqing, who was peering out from her seat, both shuddered as the man entered the bus carriage!

The two looked at each other with wide eyes and nodded at the same time.

CONTENT END 18

chapters.title: The Twelfth & Thirteenth Cycle of Time
chapters.content:
In the bus was a man wearing a black mask and a black jumper with the hood lifted up over his head.

The man was dressed up in an airtight way, and he was also carrying a black backpack in his arms.

The masked man got into the bus, without looking at the empty seats in front of him, and walked to the last row, found the corner of the bus, and sat down, but the backpack in his hand was never put down and was always clutched in his arms.

Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun were watching him the whole time, and when they saw him sit down in the back row, Xiao Heyun hurriedly sat back down next to Li Shiqing, lowering his voice and asking excitedly.

“It’s suspicious, isn’t it? Right? What kind of person rides a bus dressed like a mugger? Did this guy get on when we got off at the last stop? Was he on the bus before?”

The last time they time looped was the first time the two had stopped at a normal stop; no one had gotten off the bus at that time, and since the doors were up at the front and down at the back, they didn’t pay attention to anyone getting on the bus after they got off.

“I didn’t notice if anyone got on at the last stop.”

Li Shiqing was so preoccupied with memorizing the license plate number that she was worried about the bus running away if she was slow, so who would look back to see if anyone was getting on the bus in front of her?

“But, as suspicious as it is, this man was indeed on the bus the whole time.”

“All the time?”

Bespectacled Boy’s original excitement was thrown into the cold water by Li Shiqing’s answer.

“I remember the first time I caught the pervert; he stuck his head out and looked at the situation.”

Li Shiqing tried hard to recall, “I didn’t see it clearly, but I have an impression of the hood of his sweatshirt.”

The hood on the man’s forehead had a pair of inverted triangular eyes, as if a monster was looking at you with dangling eyes.

Li Shiqing’s eyes passed over the hood as he stuck his head out, but she didn’t see anything else as the man just stuck his head out and retracted quickly.

“Then how come I don’t remember anything about him?”

Bespectacled Boy rubbed his chin as he thought back, refusing to miss every detail in his memory.

“Well, let’s see… when I shouted ‘stop’ and was subdued…”

“He wasn’t there,” Li Shiqing continued.

“And then when I broke the window with the safety hammer and got pinned right to the ground, er… did he ever show up?”

Bespectacled Boy thought carefully.

“He wasn’t there either; you were held down by some older men in the bus.”

As she spoke, Li Shiqing also began to feel terrible.

Involuntarily, the two turned back together.

At this glance, they immediately understood why no one had noticed him before.

The masked man who had just boarded the bus was sitting in the last row, even if he was leaning against the innermost side, and usually in that position, as long as you didn’t stick your head out yourself, no one would notice that there was someone else there.

The question was, would a normal person on a bus with empty seats all over the bus not find a seat nearby but purposely sit in the back row with no windows?

“I think that would be him.”

Bespectacled Boy kept turning back nervously and whispered in Li Shiqing’s ear, “Think about it; if you were that guy, you wouldn’t choose to get on the bus too far in advance. The longer it takes, the more changes there are along the way. If you want to do something bad like that, you’d better find a place where there are fewer people, where the distance between stops is long, and the traffic is heavy. Isn’t his best bet to pick the last stop to get on the bus before the bridge and not even have a chance to get off once the bus leaves?”

“I think it’s him, too.”

Li Shiqing nodded repeatedly. “Look, he’s carrying such a big backpack, and it looks quite heavy. Shouldn’t such a bag be carried behind him? Why does he have to carry it in his arms all the time? Even if there are valuables inside, now that he is sitting alone in the last row, he should have put the bag down, right?”

She stood up and gave a quick glance behind her and sat down with an even more horrified expression.

“The bag wasn’t put down; he was still holding it in his lap.”

“What should we do? Should we go and grab his bag? What if there’s really a bomb in the bag?”

Plans being plans, the two had never been such people before, and Li Shiqing swallowed nervously.

“As originally planned, I’ll subdue the masked man, and you grab the bag!”

But we can’t go like this. Pretend you’ve had a fight with me and sit a few rows back, preferably next to him. I’ll go up and hold him down, and you’ll grab the bag right away. Come on, I have faith in your acting skills! “

Zhang Wuji’s mother said, “The better a woman looks, the more she cheats!”

Li Shiqing thought that she had to take this step, so she stood up, rolled her eyes at Bespectacled Boy, and cursed.

“You’re sick!”

The two of them had been whispering with their heads down before, looking like a young couple, and now the girl suddenly flipped out and cursed and ran backwards, and the people in the bus just thought it was a young couple having a fight and didn’t react too much.

Li Shiqing pretended to be angry and ran to the last row, found a seat furthest away from the masked man, and sat down, leaning her face against the wall as soon as she was seated, making a sulky face.

The masked man was quite nervous when he saw Li Shiqing coming straight to his row; his body subconsciously ducked inside, and his arm, which was resting on his shoulder bag, was clenched.

Although there was an aisle between them, rounding up was the same as being in close contact with the “suspect.” Li Shiqing seemed to be acting calmly, but in fact she was so anxious that her legs kept shaking unconsciously, even though she tried to calm herself down.

For fear that the masked man would notice that she was shaking in the wrong way, she had to press her hand firmly against her thigh and make a face as if she was shaking with anger.

The masked man looked at her curiously for a few moments, but only for a few moments, as he clearly did not want to meddle in the matter, let alone talk to Li Shiqing.

Poor Li Shiqing waited tremblingly in the back row, waiting for Bespectacled Boy to come to the back and “stick to the plan,” but then she saw the masked man trying to open his shoulder bag, so she coughed heavily.

“Cough!”

With a heavy cough, Bespectacled Boy, who was sitting in front of her, finally jumped up like a frightened bird and moved stiffly towards the end of the row.

“I’m wrong, I’m wrong, can’t I…”

He bent his head down and squeezed into the back row with the look of a man who had come to admit his mistake.

Many of the older men and women in the bus smiled knowingly and seemed to find the young couple quite amusing.

Once in the back row, Bespectacled Boy nervously pushed down his glasses, turned his back on the masked man, and desperately winked at Li Shiqing.

Li Shiqing blinked imperceptibly.

Receiving Li Shiqing’s ready response, Xiao Heyun took a deep breath and turned violently, pouncing on the masked man in one fluid motion, holding his hand down with outstretched arms in an attempt.

“Damn it!”

Feeling his bag being pressed against Bespectacled Boy with his body, the masked man cursed, as if he had suddenly been stabbed, and even his face changed colour.

“Li Shiqing, quick!”

Feeling what seemed to be a muffled grunt from someone, Bespectacled Boy shouted in haste.

Although he did as planned, he was in direct conflict with someone, and Xiao Heyun was more frantic than the masked man and didn’t even dare to look at the other man’s face.

“Ah!”

But before Li Shiqing could find a way to get the bag out safely, Bespectacled Boy was tipped over with a huge force.

He was kicked to the ground so viciously by the masked man that even his glasses rolled out a long way.

“Are you sick?”

The masked man kicked Bespectacled Boy’s glasses away with one foot and then nervously went to open his bag with the other.

“Xiao Heyun, quick, he’s opening the bag!”

This time, Li Shiqing was scared half to death and went screaming for his bag.

The passengers on the bus were already stunned by such a turn of events.

“What’s going on back there!”

At the front, the driver heard Li Shiqing’s screams behind him and yelled to ask for information.

“There’s been a robbery!”

The masked man shouted as he shielded his bag.

Xiao Heyun struggled to reach for his glasses on the ground and stood up just as he was about to lunge to help the young girl, when he was held down from behind.

“What are you doing? What a criminal!”

Suddenly, the bus leaned uncontrollably to the right, and everyone was terrified.

“Ah! The oil tanker!”

The passenger sitting in the front row screamed.

Bespectacled Boy looked out of the window in horror and realized that they had reached that familiar life-threatening crossroads again.

“Boom!”

The bus hit the tanker once more.

All those standing were thrown backwards and forwards by the tremendous inertia, with Bespectacled Boy and Li Shiqing falling straight to the ground.

Sprawled on the ground, the two looked up in despair.

Even after such a terrible crash, the masked man was still clinging to his bag, and as he opened it with one hand to reach in…

A familiar wave of heat swept through the bus.

—

“I saw it! It blew up after he opened the bag and reached in!”

Surviving the weakness and pain of the blast, the two began whispering head-to-head again.

“I saw it too; he was still holding on to his bag even after the accident!”

Li Shiqing also nodded her head like a chick pecking rice.

“What do we do now? Do we call the police first?”

“No, we still have to see what’s in the bag first. What if it’s not a bomb but just a detonator? Our focus is to find the bomb and the real culprit before we can hand it over to the police; otherwise, we’ll be arrested by the police.”

At the thought of it, Bespectacled Boy slapped his leg in frustration.

“Ugh, it’s so fast every time; I don’t even see where it blows up from!”

“Then let’s do it again.”

Li Shiqing bit the dust.

“This time you get in the back first, I’ll get his attention as soon as he gets in, and I’ll just grab the bag when you make a move on him!”

“You’re going straight at the masked man? Wouldn’t that be too dangerous?”

Xiao Heyun was a little hesitant.

“What’s the danger? At most a bomb!”

Speaking of which, Li Shiqing was a bit of a critic: “And what do you think is wrong with you? How am I supposed to grab the bag when you’re holding it down? And you said you went to subdue the other guy, but you just ended up tackling him?”

Li Shiqing got angrier and angrier: “Those who know think you are catching bad guys; those who don’t think you’re going to molest them!”

“I—I was just so anxious; all I could think about was not letting him touch the bag…”

Bespectacled Boy gestured awkwardly with his hands. “I used to be the one who tried to mediate. Isn’t the person who mediates a fight supposed to use their body to separate the two sides…”

“Then it’s a miracle you haven’t been killed by now.”

Li Shiqing rolled her eyes.

As they were speaking, the bus came to a stop once more, and Li Shiqing elbowed Bespectacled Boy.

“Quick, you go ahead and get ready in the back row!”

Xiao Heyun was startled by her and went to the last row with his back bent.

Li Shiqing rubbed her hands together nervously as she watched the masked man get in through the front door once more and head straight for the back…

The Bespectacled Boy clenched his fists tightly and kept practicing in his mind, thinking about which angle and which move to use to “defeat the enemy with one move.”

Closer, closer…

Bespectacled Boy’s heart was beating like a drum, and his fists were getting stronger and stronger as he saw the masked man moving closer and closer to the back row…

Suddenly, the masked man’s footsteps stopped.

Seeing someone in the last row, he showed a hint of surprise in his eyes above the mask, then looked around blankly, and then…

He sat down in the second to last row, where no one was.

CONTENT END 19

chapters.title: The Thirteenth & Fourteenth Time Cycle
chapters.content:
When he saw that the masked man was out of line, Bespectacled Boy immediately looked out at Li Shiqing with a pleading look on his face.

Li Shiqing was not one to give up easily. She immediately gave Bespectacled Boy a gesture, signaling that everything was “OK,” and waved her mobile phone to indicate that she could use the contact details she had just exchanged.

Bespectacled Boy then began to wonder, with a sad face, what he could do to assist his companion in this difficult task.

However, his poor imagination was unable to imagine how to subdue a grown man in one go, and as modern society sometimes does not require “racking one’s brains,” Bespectacled Boy gave up when he couldn’t think of anything, resigned himself to opening all the apps he could find, such as Baidu, Zhihu, and Weibo, and started searching for a topic.

[ How can I beat the enemy in one move? ]

Li Shiqing waited anxiously in her seat for his ‘instructions’; after all, it is she who was responsible for drawing attention to herself and making direct contact with the ‘thugs,’ and the longer she waited, the more nervous she became.

After a few minutes, Bespectacled Boy finally learned all the tricks with his “eyes” and sent a text message to Li Shiqing.

“OK on my end!”

When she saw the text message, Li Shiqing immediately took a deep breath, immediately cheered up, and deliberately took out her mobile phone to take a look at her face, feeling “soft and harmless” enough before she dared to stand up.

She put on a smile and headed for the man in the mask.

Sensing someone in front of him, the masked man, who had been holding his bag, raised his head and looked at Li Shiqing warily, without speaking, with a sense of displeasure at having his territory violated, like a hedgehog with spikes up.

Li Shiqing’s heart was thumping, and she stammered a little to speak: “I—I see you in this sweater, which is quite charming. My boyfriend, too, has a birthday, and I want to ask you where to buy it…”

She had no choice but to make a random excuse in her desperation. Who told her that she only remembered the black hoodie of the masked man?

While Li Shiqing accosted the masked man, Bespectacled Boy moved his hips inch by inch like a turtle, moving to the spot behind the masked man.

Hearing the girl’s question in front of him, the masked man froze for a moment, probably not thinking that his sweatshirt looked any better, but still spat out two syllables with odd eyes.

“Taobao.”

That’s it; can’t talk anymore…

Li Shiqing instantly understood that the man in front of her was a straight man of steel who would completely kill the conversation.

“That, and you have a nice bag. Is it specially made to match your attire?”

Li Shiqing had no choice but to engage in an awkward conversation when he didn’t take her words seriously.

When it came to the bag, the masked man’s eyes were obviously a little unnatural, holding the bag more cautiously, only frowning, reluctant to talk, and full of “I do not want to talk about this topic” written on his expression.

His eyes even began to glance at the other empty seats in the bus, as if to say, “I’ll just move to another seat if she doesn’t leave.”

Meanwhile, Xiao Heyun, who had moved quietly in the last row, finally reached the ‘end’ and quietly waved an arm at Li Shiqing.

Li Shiqing’s heart was already in her throat as she pointed to the bus door in front of her with an “ah” and suddenly shouted, “Look, what’s that thing over there!”

“Huh?”

The masked man raised his eyes in bewilderment, and just as he relaxed, he felt an arm wrap around his neck from behind.

“Wha-!”

Bespectacled Boy had already jumped up from the back seat, strangling the masked man with one arm and then jamming his own arm into place with the other, trapping him in his seat and alerting his companion in a panic.

“Quickly! Move your hands! I don’t want anyone to get killed!”

Before Li Shiqing could reach out, however, the masked man broke from Bespectacled Boy’s grip, and not only did he do so, but he also pulled his arm around and twisted it back.

“Ahhhhhhhhhhhh, let go!”

Xiao Heyun’s entire body was pressed backwards against the back of the front seat in a grotesque position, sweating profusely in pain and screaming out in agony.

Li Shiqing was also stunned by this sudden turn of events, and her outstretched hand retracted in fear.

The masked man glared hard at Li Shiqing, but instead of hitting her, he pulled Xiao Heyun to him and punched him in the face.

“Uhhhh!”

Bespectacled Boy covered his nose in severe pain and bent down as his glasses were knocked off again.

“What’s going on back there?!”

Once again the driver driving in front asked for information.

“There’s been a robbery!”

The masked man covered his bag and shouted, “Or a pair of male and female thieves! The woman is a distraction, and the man is trying to rob my bag by force!”

Holy shit! What the hell was this!

Li Shiqing’s mind went blank, and she didn’t want to think about anything else, nor did she expect Xiao Heyun to do so, so she pounced on him and grabbed the bag.

Xiao Heyun, who had risen from the ground, saw Li Shiqing in such a state and could not let her fight on her own, so he jumped in to help.

Seeing how arrogant the “criminals” were, the reluctant passengers in the car were enraged, and with a loud shout from the uncle in the middle of the car, whose trouser was full of keys, five or six passengers in the car swarmed together and overpowered the male and female thieves who were trying to “do something”: Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun.

As the their faces were pressed against the wall of the bus by the “enthusiasts” and the familiar heat was felt from behind, Li Shiqing’s ears seemed to reverberate with Bespectacled Boy’s resigned complaints.

“How can he break free? How could he break free?”

—

“How could he have broken free? I clearly used the naked choke taught by the fighting champion!”

Having passed from the throes of death, a devastated Xiao Heyun was still gesticulating nervously in his seat.

“I’ve got this hand around his neck and the other hand against the back of his head!”

He swung his left hand and wrapped his right around it, looking at Li Shiqing as if he wanted to try it again on her, before his leap of faith was stopped by a vicious look from Li Shiqing.

“You still want to try that on me? Didn’t get enough face on the floor, did you?”

“Twice now! Haven’t even touched a single strand of hair of the bag!”

Li Shiqing said with annoyance.

“I’m here to correct you on a statement: the bag is hairless. That bag is a bag made of rainproof cloth; in theory you should say, ‘Even the cloth…'”

“You say that again?!”

The girl made a ‘choke’ gesture, which scared Bespectacled Boy into not making noises again.

“I think we need to change our options; let’s just outsmart him.”

Li Shiqing, mindful of Bespectacled Boy’s pride, didn’t directly say “no” to him but lowered her voice to discuss, “Why don’t we change our thinking and wait for him to get in the bus, you quietly put your leg out, and when he trips over, we’ll go over and grab the bag?”

“What if we accidentally set off an explosive device?”

Bespectacled Boy shook his head hastily and whispered, “I think my plan will work better; I’ll subdue, you do ……”

Bespectacled Boy’s voice became lower and lower until it became inaudible, as he saw his companion’s eyes grow fierce.

“You subdue again?”

Li Shiqing was so exasperated that she yelled at the top of her lungs, “I didn’t want to say anything, but you have the nerve to yell at me, ‘Quickly, I don’t want anyone to get killed!’? Yes, yes, someone almost got killed, but it was you who almost got killed!”

Was there a ‘choke’ that you could break free of in less than a second?

She had seen it all today!

“Also, even if your glasses flew off and you couldn’t see, you can’t just grab randomly, right? I was going with you to tackle a suspect, and I’d already rushed into his arms, and you mistook my hair for a bag and forcibly ripped me off! If you’re blind, don’t make things worse!”

Li Shiqing had a lot of anger when it came to this.

“How could you wrongly grab me with such an obvious ponytail?”

When it came to “subduing the suspect,” Xiao Heyun was clearly in the wrong, constantly lagging behind. So, like a drowned quail, he could only listen obediently, though he couldn’t help but grumble when he felt particularly aggrieved.

“Am I not nearsighted with astigmatism? You people with good eyes don’t understand the pain we feel…”

He had 800 degrees of myopia, which meant he couldn’t tell men from women within a hundred meters and couldn’t tell people from animals beyond a hundred meters. Add to that his panic, and it was only natural that he’d grabbed the wrong person.

“That naked chokehold, I swear I really learned it!”

If the eyes learned it, then the hands would learn it, right? That’s it!

“It’s normal that I can’t beat him. I’ve only ever played computer games before, never actual humans! And he’s so strong; he must be a martial artist, or maybe my body is just weak from all the constant practice!”

In short, it definitely had nothing to do with him being “weak”!

“I’ve done it more times than you!”

After repeatedly trying to do something and failing, Li Shiqing was so furious that she wanted to jump up and down.

“If you don’t agree to outsmart us, let’s do it the other way around. I’ll subdue him, and you get the bag!”

“Well, how could that be…”

Bespectacled Boy hesitantly pushed his glasses up. “Then, let’s outsmart him.”

If he failed to subdue him and was subdued by a girl, wouldn’t that be even more embarrassing?

“So why are you arguing with me?”

Although her companion had agreed with her, Li Shiqing couldn’t help but complain.

Her companion always laid out a plan in detail and always somehow messed it up. It was driving her crazy!

Although they had decided to “outsmart” the situation, considering it wasn’t safe to do it alone, Bespectacled Boy and Li Shiqing discussed it and decided to split up and sit on either side of the aisle. That way, no matter which way the masked man fell, they could grab the bag.

After a tense discussion, the bus once again stopped at the familiar sound of the station announcement, and the masked man once again got on the bus, clutching his bag.

Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun were staring nervously at the masked man’s… feet, not blinking as they watched his every footfall, and Xiao Heyun was even calculating the rhythm of his stride and the distance he had travelled, mentally estimating how many steps he would have to take to reach him.

He quietly prepared his foot and stretched it out on the seventh count.

The masked man, walking normally, hadn’t noticed the extra foot beneath him. Suddenly, he felt something, and his body swayed…

[ It worked! Precise calculations are the foundation of success! ]

The young man cried out in surprise.

“Ah!”

The next moment, however, a sharp pain came from his toe.

“Ah, sorry! Sorry I didn’t see your feet!”

Instead of being startled by the extra foot under his feet, the masked man was so startled by Bespectacled Boy’s scream that he fell backwards in the opposite direction.

Li Shiqing, who was sitting next to him, was quick enough to bend at the waist and pull the bag out of Bespectacled Boy’s unsteady hand.

Until the heavy bag arrived in her hand, Li Shiqing still felt a little surreal.

“It’s that simple … to get it?”

Her mind was incredulous, but her reaction was quick.

Seeing that the masked man had not yet reacted, she catapulted herself under his armpits and ran towards the front of the bus with his bag in her arms, shouting as she ran.

“Uncle, don’t look at us; we’re fine. Watch out for the motorbike at the junction on your right!”

“Hey, what are you doing?”

When the masked man saw that someone had snatched his bag, his face changed, and he turned his head to give chase, only to be blocked by Bespectacled Boy’s outstretched arm.

“I’ll fight you!”

When Bespectacled Boy saw that Li Shiqing had indeed grabbed the bag, his emotions lifted, and he lunged towards the masked man, not caring about anything.

“You’re not going to do anything today!”

“Where’s the crazy guy from, shit! What are you doing?”

The masked man was so caught in Bespectacled Boy’s bear hug that he nearly fell to the ground. He only managed to hold onto the seatback.

“Li Shiqing, open the bag!”

Bespectacled Boy roared!

“No!”

The masked man, who was still seething with rage, blushed and blurted out.

However, it was too late. Li Shiqing, with a smug smile, unzipped his backpack and yanked it open.

When she saw what was inside, her smile froze.

The kitten, wrapped in the coat, sensed the light outside and peeked curiously through the bag’s opening. It tilted its head and let out a sweet, delicate sound…

“Meow?”

CONTENT END 20

chapters.title: The Fifteenth Cycle of Time
chapters.content:
Although it was only a quick glance, Li Shiqing could see that it was a young cat in poor condition; not only was it thin and weak, but its voice was even weaker, its fur was still dirty with the characteristic dirt of a stray cat, and its eyes were only round and watery because they were so thin, making it look pitiful.

Even Li Shiqing, who had just been covered in thorns, softened at the sight of such eyes and gently closed the bag again, holding it carefully so that it would not jump out of the bag and fall.

Exactly the same action as the masked man who had just gotten into the bus.

On the other hand, the ‘fight’ between the masked man and Bespectacled Boy ended with Bespectacled Boy being unilaterally beaten and bruised, and Bespectacled Boy losing all motivation the moment he saw the cat’s head exposed, complaining reluctantly:

“You have a cat in your bag; why are you being so cautious?”

“Why do you care so much? What, I’m sorry for not having valuables in my bag?”

The masked man, however, clearly misunderstood what he meant by that and got even more fired up.

He glared at Bespectacled Boy, ran to the front of the bus in two or three steps, and snatched his bag from Li Shiqing’s hand without being polite at all just because she was a woman.

No, perhaps it had been polite; at least he hadn’t made a move on her.

The passengers on the bus witnessed the farce and started talking about it.

“You look so pretty and young; how could you do such a thing…”

“Robbery on the bus in broad daylight is so lawless…”

“But isn’t it also wrong for this young man to bring a cat on the bus? Pets shouldn’t be taken on public transportation. What if someone is allergic to animal hair?”

Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun were so upset by this misunderstanding that they wanted to dig a hole in the ground and crawl into it.

After the masked man was exposed for bringing a cat on the bus, he was very dissatisfied with the two people, especially since some people on the bus had already started talking about “pets are not allowed on buses”, which made him even more furious.

It was obvious that he only needed to sit for one stop while holding the stray cat he had picked up!

When he got angry, he thought about the two robbers standing there with innocent faces, as if it was really a misunderstanding. The more he thought about it, the angrier he got. Before Li Shiqing and Bespectacled Boy could react, he took out his cell phone.

“Hello, is this 110? I want to call the police.”

As soon as the masked man made a call, he saw with satisfaction that the expression of Bespectacled Boy who had just robbed his bag changed drastically.

Are you scared now?

You should be!

“No!”

Li Shiqing felt a chill when she saw him calling the police, and she pleaded loudly:

“Don’t call the police!”

Once the police are called…

“Yes, I’m on the Bus 45, about to get on the bridge. There are two robbers on the bus, and they just stole my bag. Yes, they’re still on the bus; please send someone as soon as possible…”

Boom!

The familiar heat wave swept through the entire bus, and everyone was shattered to pieces once again.

—

“We’ve already wasted four rounds searching for just one suspect. If we continue searching at this rate, we might end up having to retreat to the final station.”

Coming out of the negative state, Li Shiqing looked at another bus stop faintly visible behind the window and felt a chill in his heart and shuddered.

“We’re almost backing up to Gangwu New Village Station. What will happen if we keep going back?”

This bus line had a total of 17 stops. Li Shiqing and Xiao Heyun both boarded the bus at the starting stop, which was in the Jiangdong District, where many universities and startups were located. Most people boarded the bus from here.
