The first person has been shattered, and I won’t change the second person no matter what. You ask why I do this? Because it’s fun. I’ve seen many readers worry about me, wondering if I write this way because I care about what they think. My answer is no. When I write books, I respect and value the readers’ opinions, but that doesn’t mean I like to write according to the readers’ ideas. If I were a person who caters to the market, my ideas would not be so “weird,” there would be no old lady with diabetes insipidus, no male-like Mulan, and I would not give up my skills and write about realistic themes, suspense themes, or workplace themes when I have already laid the foundation in ancient Chinese. All my writing is done because I want to. I want to try all kinds of genres, all kinds of possibilities, to see where my limits lie.

CONTENT END 42

chapters.title: The Undeliverable Package (Part 2)
chapters.content:
You think you’re delusional from not getting enough sleep, so you weakly ask if you can take a day off to get some more sleep.

The cold-faced team leader tells you that you can take a day off, but you can’t give up your job. So you timidly say it was just a joke, head down, and choose to continue delivering packages.

Even if something strange happens, you still have to eat.

Your master, fearing you’re nervous, pats your shoulder and looks at you with a fatherly expression:

“Xiao Song, I know you’re scared on your first day delivering packages after leaving me. Don’t be nervous. Every courier has that day sooner or later!”

You: …???

You want to complain that it’s not your first day anymore, but you force yourself to hold it back.

Is it a dream or reality? You decide to deliver a package again to test your own thinking. This time, you’d sorted the packages you remembered you couldn’t deliver in advance, but you had delivered so many yesterday that you couldn’t remember many. So, you decided to go deliver the one to the perverted property management company first. It was familiar, so filling out the forms wasn’t a big deal. Leaving the packages at the security office would save time.

Your driver saw you sorting through the car and praised your organized and thoughtful work, saying you were born for this job.

You drove off.

You’d bought a pancake, soy milk, a pack of cigarettes, and several lollipops in advance, taking the same route as last time.

You saw the homeless old man on the roadside again. You got out and offered him soy milk and pancakes. From chatting, you learned that this was his first time “resting” there.

For many days, he’d been sleeping under the overpass. Yesterday, the city launched a cleanup operation targeting the area beneath the overpass, and he had been “cleaned out” as part of the city’s urban landscape.

Feeling heartbroken, you left the old man fifty yuan and left.

You arrived at “Programmer Street.” This time, you proactively showed the property management your work ID and business card and offered cigarettes to several security guards, earning their trust.

“Slapstick!”

Amidst the mixed looks of disdain and envy from couriers from other companies, you were led to the property management office.

There was water and a table and chairs in the office. You sat down and easily registered your deliveries. Then, with the security guards, you moved the packages to the storage room before leaving in your delivery truck.

The rest, however, required more effort.

You cheered yourself up and began delivering to the family whose buns you’d been dreaming of.

You had called ahead, climbed to the seventh floor, and knocked on the door of “Buns’ House.”

The exhausted hostess opened the door, holding a crying, chubby child, and asked you to help her place the package in the entryway. You arrived early this time, and there were no buns on the table.

You sniffed in disappointment.

The little chubby boy was clamoring to go out and play, constantly struggling with the hostess. Seeing how hard it was for her to take care of a child alone, you pulled out a few newly bought Fujiya lollipops from your pocket and tried to comfort him.

The little chubby boy stopped crying and started playing with your lollipops. The hostess breathed a sigh of relief, finally having a free hand to take the receipt from you and sign her own name.

“Sorry, I ate your lollipop.”

After taking your lollipop, the hostess apologized, “I’m steaming buns. They’re almost done. Take two. They’re homemade, and the meat filling is absolutely safe!”

You suppressed the urge to nod, but the hostess forced two meat buns into your mouth and politely walked you to the door.

You went downstairs and began devouring the buns.

Wow, they smell so good!

After a full stomach, I’m no longer dizzy and have more energy to climb the stairs.

You quickly delivered all the packages you could, then checked your phone. In just two hours, you’d already met your morning quota.

It was just ten o’clock, and the new packages hadn’t been sorted yet, and your driver hadn’t called you. After some thought, you decided to take advantage of this free time to go out for a walk and get some ideas.

Your heart led you to the lottery station.

You’ve never bought a lottery ticket before, but that doesn’t stop you from dreaming of winning the jackpot, even though you don’t even know how to buy one.

You learned from the lottery station owner that the current jackpot is already 700 million yuan, and the jackpot could be drawn at any time. The drawing is at 9:15 PM.

You declined the station owner’s suggestion to buy a lottery ticket, and to his puzzled expression, you said you’d come back at 9:15 PM.

After leaving the lottery station, you made more than a dozen calls, and this time you finally got through. You decided to deliver the tickets first.

After delivering packages to several homes, one family asked you to take their trash downstairs. You glanced at the garbage spilling out in the corner and declined.

As soon as you got downstairs, you discovered you’d been given a negative review and accused of “not wanting to go upstairs to deliver packages.”

You angrily went upstairs and knocked on the door, trying to reason with them. The owner refused to open the door, saying they’d delete the negative review if you took the trash downstairs.

Forced to make ends meet, you gritted your teeth and carried the heavy trash downstairs. After dropping it into the trash can downstairs, you discovered the negative review had indeed been deleted, and the comment had been changed to “I’ll even take out the trash.”

You began to worry about whether others would follow suit and ask you to take out their trash if they saw this comment.

After you finished taking out the trash and were about to leave in the delivery truck downstairs, an elderly woman ran out of the apartment building, mop in hand, and hit you in the face.

You quickly grabbed the mop to prevent the smelly mop cloth from covering your face.

But the next moment, the old lady started yelling, “It turns out the wastewater from the garbage you’ve brought down has stained the hallway and her doorway.”

The community doesn’t have a property management company, so everyone has to take care of their own sanitation. She believed you had polluted the hallway.

After trying to explain yourself to no avail, you resigned yourself to your fate, grabbed the mop, and, despite the strange looks from the others, mopped the hallway of your apartment building.

Leaving the complex, you felt the stench of garbage all over you, so you parked your car at the entrance of a public restroom and cleaned yourself briefly.

After leaving, you felt like you didn’t want to deliver packages anymore, so you decided to go back to the delivery point to rest.

After inspecting your delivery truck, the driver praised your diligence and hard work and reaffirmed your talent as a courier.

During lunch, you complained to your colleagues about your morning garbage collection. The driver told you to record and complain to the company next time you encounter such a situation. There’s no need to put yourself in a difficult position, nor to give in to unreasonable demands from others.

With your master’s support, you felt a surge of strength.

After a satisfying meal, the sorter unloaded a newly filled cart of packages, and you set off again.

It was 2:00 PM. You’d already identified those who were napping and wouldn’t answer your calls and placed their packages to the right, deciding to deliver them later.

You found the package from “Mr. Xiao Heyun” and called again.

The phone was still off, and you expressed your annoyance. To avoid damaging this “valuable” digital product, you decided not to take it with you and would leave it at the delivery point.

You began a new journey.

After successfully delivering most of the packages, you called the owner of a package and asked her to come down and pick it up.

The owner’s voice was pleasant, a soft, sweet, lolita voice.

She explained that the package was large and heavy and hoped you would deliver it.

You looked at the large package labeled “cat litter” and suddenly remembered this package.

Yesterday, you couldn’t even get through on the phone. The large package remained in the car, needing to be moved downstairs that evening.

Today, you finally got through, and the woman sounded quite delicate. After a brief hesitation, you promised to deliver it to her door.

After delivering the other deliveries in the neighborhood, you parked your car downstairs and, carrying a 20-pound bag of cat litter, trudged up to the fifth floor.

But when you rang the doorbell, no one answered.

Thinking about how exhausted you were carrying 20 pounds of stuff up the stairs and how the woman hadn’t even opened the door for you, you angrily called her again.

You heard the phone ring from inside the door, followed by a banging noise, and froze.

This had happened before: the recipient of a package might be disheveled or in a hurry, and they’d ask you and the driver to wait outside.

But this had never happened before. Not even a single word.

Sensing something was wrong, you called the girl’s phone again. The call was hung up this time, and there was still no answer from the other end, so you began knocking.

You knocked relentlessly for a minute or two before a man finally answered, telling you his daughter was asleep and asking you to stop knocking and come back later to deliver the package.

“Okay!”

You said this, but you crouched down suspiciously, pressing your ear to the door, giving the illusion that you were gone.

“You dared to scratch me, you little bastard! You want to die!”

A few seconds later, you heard someone roaring furiously from inside.

How could your own cat attack someone?

Seeing the situation was bad, you called the police while kicking the door.

The owner of this house had a very strong security door, and even after kicking your foot until it was swollen, the door frame was only slightly warped.

The neighbor next door was startled by the loud noise and opened the door. You told the old man your identity and your suspicions: you thought the little girl might have met with a bad guy at home, so he couldn’t open the door for you.

The old man next door agreed.

The girl was a single tenant, not living with her father.

You worried that if you delayed any longer, something even more horrific would happen to her, and you began pacing anxiously at the door.

Then the old man explained that the two balconies were connected, and the little girl appeared to have left her balcony window open that morning. You could jump from his balcony to the next door.

Although you’d already called the police, it might take time for them to arrive. Eager to save someone, you followed the old man to his balcony. Sure enough, the window on the girl’s balcony was open.

Since it was the fifth floor, neither house had security bars, so you could climb over.

You glanced downstairs. It was all concrete, with no lawn or flowers to cushion your fall. If you slipped and fell, you’d be in danger of falling to your death.

A cat’s shrill cry began to echo from next door, and you faced a stark choice.

Should I wait for the police to arrive while yelling at the neighbors to scare off any potential bad guys?

Or should I simply climb up to the fifth-floor balcony and jump over to save the person?

CONTENT END 43

chapters.title: The Undeliverable Package (Part 3)
chapters.content:
After a brief moment of hesitation, you chose to jump.

During your military service, you always topped the “climbing and obstacle course” training and had demonstrated it to new recruits many times. You were confident in your climbing abilities, believing this simple obstacle was within your capabilities.

You told the old man to wait downstairs for the police while you nimbly climbed over the air conditioning rack on the balcony.

As you reached the other person’s balcony, you saw a middle-aged man also running towards the balcony, carrying a rope and a bag, as if trying to escape.

You came face to face with him. He was dark and fierce-looking, and it was obvious he was not a good person.

Seeing you trying to climb in through the balcony window, he immediately rushed towards you with a sullen face. Feeling uneasy, you tried to rush through the window, but he shoved you out with a cruel shove!

You felt the dizziness of weightlessness and the fear of falling so rapidly.

The fear fueled your adrenaline, energizing your mind. In the nick of time, with your extraordinary arm strength and sharp reflexes, you clung tightly to the security net on the third-floor balcony, your body dangling in midair.

You dangled from the balcony, looking around, trying to save yourself, deeply concerned for the safety of the girl upstairs.

Anyone who dared to push someone down must be a ruthless and vicious person.

Just then, you felt a sound coming from above. You looked up and saw it was the middle-aged man descending from the balcony using a rope.

Your arms were so strained that they hurt, and you didn’t dare call for help from the residents on the third floor, fearing the villain above would notice you.

You held on like this for three or four minutes until you saw the villain step onto the security net on the third floor and prepare to continue descending.

As the man lowered his head, searching for a way out, his eyes met yours again.

Seeing him about to step on you, you chose to “take the initiative” this time, releasing your right hand and yanking fiercely at his ankle, pulling him down with all your might.

He lost his balance and fell through the third-floor security net. Quickly following, you dove and clung to him.

The man’s safety rope saved you both. You used your arms to wrap around the man’s body, leaving both of you dangling from the second-floor window.

The police finally arrived, and you screamed for help. They saw you hanging from the second-floor window, freed you, and subdued the dark-skinned man.

You told them you were the one who called the police, and an elderly neighbor testified on your behalf. Worried about the girl upstairs, you followed the police upstairs. The police had called a locksmith, and he arrived a short time later and opened the security door.

The room was a mess, with signs of rummaging everywhere. You found the girl who had been on the phone on the sofa in the living room. Her clothes were disheveled, and her head was covered in blood and visible wounds. She lay unconscious on the sofa.

Under the sofa lay a dying cat. Seeing you approach, it struggled to open its eyes, glanced at you, then closed them again.

The girl was taken to the hospital by the police. You went to the police station with the suspect to assist in the investigation and present evidence as a witness.

You called your driver to report the incident, explaining that you might not be able to complete your delivery today and asking him to cover a shift for you and come to the police station to take your delivery truck.

Your driver was concerned for your safety and offered to deliver the package tomorrow, allowing you to focus on assisting the police.

So you stayed at the police station until evening.

As a caring and courageous courier, you received praise from the police but also considerable criticism.

They denied your dangerous plans of “jumping out the window” or “knocking the inmate downstairs,” believing they could easily cause manslaughter and endanger their own lives.

After a police investigation, you learned that the burglar was a convicted raper and murderer who had recently been released from prison and now makes a living repairing and cleaning air conditioners.

Before the incident, he was supposed to be cleaning and repairing the apartment downstairs, but he went to the wrong floor.

The homeowner opened the door to the AC repairman without asking, mistaking him for a cat litter deliveryman. Upon discovering the girl was living alone, the intruder became motivated to commit a crime. He exploited her relaxed state of mind to force his way into the house and prepare to commit his crime.

However, he was quickly startled by you, who happened to be delivering a package.

The girl struggled violently when you knocked on the door. To prevent you from noticing anything was wrong, he struck her head with a hard object, knocking her unconscious. He then attempted to dissuade you with words and continued his crime.

During this process, the girl’s cat attacked him, kicking him several times and severely injuring him.

Realizing he couldn’t escape through the door, the criminal looted the house for valuables and attempted to escape through the balcony, using his skills, honed from repairing air conditioners. However, he was intercepted by you, who also wanted to enter the house through the balcony, and was eventually apprehended.

As you left the police station, you learned that the girl was still unconscious. Her family wanted to meet you and express their gratitude in person, but you refused their request, feeling deeply guilty.

You believe that your willingness to deliver cat litter caused the girl to let down her guard and open the door to a stranger, and that your slowness prevented her from escaping.

You worried that your kicking the door had provoked the criminal and blamed yourself for not realizing the mistake and jumping out the window of the neighboring house instead of trying to break down the door…

Flacking with regret, you drove your delivery truck back to the business location, only to find that the cold-faced team leader hadn’t left work and was waiting for you. The team leader personally counted your remaining packages and breathed a sigh of relief when he found nothing missing. He explained that today’s circumstances were special, and while you didn’t complete your assignment, you wouldn’t be fined.

However, he then gently reminded you that it was only your first day on the job and you didn’t have workers’ compensation insurance. Furthermore, if you were to get into an accident or get injured as a result of this, the company could theoretically refuse compensation. He urged you to refrain from impulsive behavior and even more so from trying to be a hero next time.

Dejected, you returned to your rented basement. The aching arm and tearing back reminded you that you’d been injured in that thrilling encounter.

But you didn’t have health insurance, so you had to endure it alone.

You found some safflower oil and applied it to your injuries alone. Enduring the pain, you closed your eyes, concluding this eventful day.

》》》

The next day, you woke up feeling rejuvenated.

Feeling the relief, you began to realize you might be repeating yesterday.

The date on your phone confirmed your guess.

Yesterday was so thrilling and exciting that it only just now occurred to you that you forgot to check your lottery winnings!

You were so heartbroken that you almost had no energy to get out of bed, but remembering that there was still a chance of winning today, you forced yourself to get up and wash up.

After breakfast, you brought breakfast to your colleagues at the delivery point and were the first to arrive.

Your mentor arrived at the office second and opened the door for you.

Taking the breakfast from you, he praised your spirited attitude on your first day and your commitment to your colleagues. He then boasted to the new colleagues about how “well-behaved and sensible” his apprentice was.

You sorted and loaded the packages as quickly as you could, your movements as skillful as if you’d been there for a long time.

Your mentor was worried you couldn’t handle the sheer volume of tasks, but you assured him you could.

You bought more cigarettes, breakfast, and lollipops. As usual, you gave breakfast to the homeless elderly, then went to “Programmers’ Street,” using cigarettes to befriend the security guard, and delivered even more packages than yesterday.

You climbed countless flights of stairs, delivering packages that would have been missed if you’d waited any longer. Then you went to “Little Fatty’s” house and successfully traded a lollipop for two steamed buns.

In the remaining time, you returned to the delivery point and helped the sorters sort the newly arrived packages and sort out a new batch of deliveries.

The cold-faced team leader treated you with a warm smile, eager to hire a few more “hardworking” employees like you.

You hurriedly ate a small meal, unwilling to waste a moment, and prepared to set off with a new load of packages.

Just then, another batch of packages arrived at the delivery point, including Xiao Heyun’s cash-on-delivery package. Your driver called and suggested you come back and reload some of the new packages before leaving. You declined, explaining that you were already quite far away.

You weren’t going to deliver the afternoon’s batch of packages. The owners of these packages were either taking a nap, had their phones turned off like Xiao Heyun, or were still at work, asking you to deliver them that evening.

“Is that Qin Rourou? Your cat litter is here.”

You dug around in the car for the cat litter and called the girl you’d met yesterday.

You agreed to deliver the cat litter, emphatically reminding her never to open the door to strangers and that you’d call her when you got there.

The girl thanked you for your attentiveness over the phone and promised you she wouldn’t open the door for you.

You quickly carried the twenty-pound bag of cat litter upstairs. After confirming your identity over the phone, the girl opened the door for you.

Yesterday, you didn’t see her face clearly because it was covered in blood. Today, you realized that the girl with the lolita voice wasn’t a young girl but a well-developed, mature woman, though her voice was younger.

You placed the cat litter in the entrance where she’d requested it. The cat meowed at you and rubbed against your feet.

“How strange! My cat is so unfriendly…”

The woman named Qin Rourou, slightly surprised, squatted down and picked up her cat.

“Maybe it just clicks with you.”

You don’t know how a person and a cat can “click.” After signing for the delivery, you repeatedly remind her not to open the door alone. Even if it’s a deliveryman or a home appliance repairman, they should verify their identity and make sure there’s no danger before opening the door.

The woman thanked you again and asked if you could exchange a private phone number or WeChat ID so she could confirm it was you when a package arrived.

You: …???

Does this woman have you delivering cat litter every day?

Carrying twenty pounds up the stairs every day would be exhausting, wouldn’t it?

You firmly agreed to her request for your WeChat ID, and she disappointedly walked you out.

After leaving, you didn’t leave immediately. Instead, you continued making phone calls outside the building, asking other residents in the neighborhood to pick up their packages.

You lingered there until two o’clock. Seeing the air conditioner worker from yesterday enter the hallway, you followed him inside.

The air conditioner worker once again “mistakenly” went upstairs. You watched closely from the next floor and breathed a sigh of relief when the girl didn’t open the door for him.

But you noticed the worker didn’t leave. Instead, he stood at the girl’s door, asking questions about whether the air conditioner needed maintenance. So you rushed up to the fifth floor and shouted.

“What are you doing? Why aren’t you leaving my door?”

You successfully scared the worker off and once again refused the girl’s offer to come in and sit down. You watched him go to the house on the fourth floor, where the AC unit was being repaired.

You called the police, informing them that you saw a worker “scouting” the building suspiciously. After waiting for someone to come and verify the situation, you drove the delivery truck and left the complex.

No one was hurt this time, and you were overjoyed. Your mission for the day was nearly complete.

At this point, you could choose to park your car in a safe place for the afternoon and go out and “fish”;

Or you could choose to drive back to the delivery point and load another truckload of goods, earning more money and, by the way, earning the approval of your colleagues and bosses;

You begin to hesitate.

Author’s Comments: Mini-Theatre: Beauty: Can I add you on WeChat? You: (Denied) You’re trying to trick me into carrying cat litter every day? No way! Beauty: …

CONTENT END 44

chapters.title: Undeliverable Package (Part 4)
chapters.content:
You’re someone who can handle boredom very well. You don’t feel tired even if you do something over and over again. You have good stamina, and the strain of delivering packages up and down stairs isn’t as severe as the training you experienced back then.

But you start to worry that if you overperform on your first day, you’ll be faced with even more tasks and quotas.

So, after some thought, you decide to park your car in a safe place and go out for a walk.

After locking your car, you start to think about what you can do with the next half day. In order to save money on living in a big city, you have been living frugally in the past few months. Now you think that since time repeats itself, you might as well splurge and eat something delicious.

You pulled out the cash from your pocket, a total of 520 yuan.

You had over 2,000 yuan in your Alipay and WeChat wallets, the basic salary you’d saved during your internship. Looking at your savings, you suddenly felt confident that you could have a “delicious” meal.

You pulled out your phone and began searching for local gourmet food.

Ten minutes later, you fell silent as you looked at the recommended prices: “200” and “300” per person. You decisively closed the “gourmet food” section and searched for “special snacks.”

“It’s a waste to eat all the delicacies by yourself. Let’s just have some snacks,” you said to yourself.

You arrived at the famous local snack street and happily feasted.

Garlic crayfish, spicy crab, teppanyaki, beef noodles, red bean paste… You ordered all the snacks you usually wouldn’t eat and ate until you were full.

Perhaps they’d never seen a delivery guy go to a snack street and eat a lot; so many people were secretly pointing and commenting on you.

You were slumped in a snack stall chair, wearing your company delivery uniform, receiving strange looks from everyone. You decided you needed to change.

You usually wear a uniform to work, having been accustomed to it in the army. You don’t bring much with you, and you only wear it on days off.

The weather is getting colder, but you haven’t had time to buy new clothes. You’re afraid to go into any store, worried about accidentally spending half a month’s living expenses.

But now is different. By the time you buy a lottery ticket, you might have hundreds of millions, hahaha!

So you went to a very famous local mall and headed straight to the third floor, where the high-end menswear was located.

The mall windows displayed the latest fall and winter menswear. Each piece looked particularly stylish and high-quality. You looked around, your expression filled with satisfaction, as if you could buy the entire mall.

You’ve taken a fancy to a stylish leather bomber jacket and stepped into the store, only to find no one to greet you.

You couldn’t find the jacket inside the store, so you approached a receptionist and asked where the jacket in the window by the door was.

The clerk didn’t even look up or answer your question, simply saying that it wouldn’t suit you and suggesting you go to the fifth floor.

The fifth floor is where the sports brands are, and you wondered why.

“This is imported Italian sheepskin. You’re a courier, right? Sheepskin is delicate and wears easily, so it wouldn’t suit you,” the clerk said, looking you up and down. “And it’s 8,800 yuan; even with the discount, it’s still over 8,000 yuan…”

After hearing the price, you suddenly decided that the jacket wasn’t that great after all and left the store dejected.

Leaving the store, you began to reflect on why you had shown such a sense of timidity. You felt like the amount of money in your wallet was limiting your thinking. After all, those hundreds of millions weren’t in your hands yet, so you couldn’t bear to spend them.

And you had no money to spend.

So, donning your courier’s uniform, you followed the teller’s advice and trudged up to the fifth floor.

The clerks at the sportswear store on the fifth floor greeted you warmly and recommended a variety of wear-resistant and cold-weather products. Feeling their gentle warmth and reflecting on their previous indifference, you gritted your teeth and bought yourself a winter jacket and a new pair of sneakers.

You didn’t bother going to the fitting room, so you tried on your coat in the lobby. As soon as you took it off, several clerks started complimenting your figure, praising your muscular build.

You knew it was a sales tactic, so you steadfastly resisted the sugar-coated offer and declined their advances, offering you two pairs of pants to try on.

The pretty cashier glanced at your waist and legs with disappointment. She tried to persuade you several times, but you still refused with a stern face.

“No, I’m not wearing any underpants, and changing in the fitting room is too much trouble!”

You’re afraid of the heat, so you only wear one pair of pants in the winter.

The fitting room was stuffy, and changing pants wasn’t like changing coats and shoes. You had to pay attention to your hips and waist, and you had to measure the length of the pants, which was a hassle.

Hearing your words, the pretty cashier’s look grew even more disappointed.

You paid for your new shoes and coat, and your heart ached as you watched your Alipay balance rapidly decrease.

Wow, I should have stopped eating so much meat.

You can’t wear spicy crab and crayfish!

After paying, the woman who had just persuaded you to buy pants politely asked if she could add you as her contact. You looked at her warily and flatly refused.

Are you kidding me? If I add you, will I be sold new clothes and pants every day?

As a man in uniform, you don’t need so many new clothes!

You returned to where you parked your car and drove the delivery truck home to put away your new clothes and pants, deciding to wear them on your week off.

Looking at the time, it was already six o’clock. You drove the delivery truck back to the delivery point and, passing by a braised food stall, bought some braised vegetables to give your colleagues a snack.

Back at the delivery point, you checked the packages that hadn’t been delivered that day and found that the package from “Xiao Heyun” was still there. You couldn’t help but feel lucky that you hadn’t taken it. Your driver, looking at your nearly empty delivery truck, expressed his deepest praise for your work.

You took out the braised vegetables you bought and asked the driver to give your colleagues a snack. Seeing the braised vegetables, the driver happily took out a few bottles of beer and decided to enjoy a good evening.

At this point, you tentatively asked the driver and the cold-faced team leader if you could leave work first, saying you had something to do that evening.

Since you completed your work assignments today and brought some delicious food, the cold noodles team leader made an exception and allowed you to leave work early.

As your colleagues happily pulled up the small table to eat, you heard some praising you, saying, “Although you’re frugal, you’re not stingy,” while others lamented that you wouldn’t be able to enjoy the delicious food and wine tonight.

You smell the aroma of meat as you walk out of the office, unable to resist a burp.

You ate too much that afternoon, and even your burps are spicy.

On the way home, you check the time and see there are still a few hours until the lottery draw.

After a busy few months, having just settled down in this big city, this is the first time you’ve left work so early. Looking at the streets, lit up by the night sky, you don’t know where to go or who to talk to.

This city is so big, and you’re busy every day trying to survive in it, but its joy and prosperity don’t seem to belong to you.

You don’t wake up knowing what goals you need to accomplish tomorrow, and you no longer strive to surpass your yesterday self every day. You don’t sleep next to your comrades who would have shared your training.

You start to miss your unit, the men who slept in the bunk below you, even if eight out of ten of them have smelly feet.

Feeling inexplicably down, you returned to your rental. Looking at your newly bought clothes on the bed, you decided to splurge…

–Go take a bath at the large bathhouse.

The basement you lived in was a converted garage. There was no bathroom, just a simple sink for washing, originally intended for car washing.

In the summer, you could just scrub yourself, but now that the weather was cooler, showering had become a hassle.

You hadn’t had a proper bath in two months, so without much hesitation, you decided to go to the legendary “everything available” large bathhouse.

You packed your toiletries and, following the directions on your phone’s map, drove the delivery van to the nearest bathhouse, Huaqing Pool.

The doorman mistook you for a delivery and directed you to the back door.

You drowsily parked your car at the back door, entered, and stepped into the luxurious bathhouse lobby.

The lobby was furnished with European-style sofas and coffee tables, and a scent you couldn’t place was on. The thick, long-pile carpet beneath your feet felt soft and mushy, completely unlike the feeling of groundedness.

You looked up, stunned by the countless nude paintings in the Western oil painting style adorning the dome.

The last time you saw such an exaggerated dome was when you accompanied your master to a lavish five-star hotel to deliver a package. But the angels in that dome were clothed.

Thinking it was perhaps a characteristic of the bathhouse, you uncomfortably went to the front desk.

“Send the package to the back…”

The smiling receptionist, dressed in a suit, said, “It’s hard to pick up packages in the front.”

“I’m here to bathe,” you said.

At your words, a smiling waiter beside you immediately brought you a cup of scented tea.

You were feeling a bit thirsty, so you gulped down the jasmine tea in one gulp.

“Excuse me, would you like a bath, a steam bath, a dry steam bath, a spa, or a wellness combo?”

The receptionist asked politely.

“Huh?”

For a moment, you thought they were about to make you into a dish and were asking you how many ways to eat it, so you were a little confused.

“Just… just a bath.”

You said hesitantly.

“Would you like to have a meal?”

The receptionist asked again, “We have dinner.”

When you heard there was a meal, you marveled at the fact that the large bathhouse really lived up to its reputation of having “everything available,” and then you said you didn’t need dinner.

You still had a lot of undigested snacks in your stomach.

“Not including meals, not including any other activities, the total is 158 yuan. The leisure area, gym, and various baths are all free. The third floor is a rest area where you can sleep for a while. There’s a restaurant on the first floor, and a waiter will guide you inside to check in your belongings.”

The receptionist checked you in and handed you a pass.

Hearing that a bath would cost 158 ​​yuan, you felt like you’d entered a scam.

Looking at the other person’s smiling face, you wistfully pulled out your phone to pay for your “shower.”

After checking in your belongings with the staff and changing into your bathrobe and slippers, you decided to recoup your 158 yuan and enjoy a good night’s sleep.

It would be best if you could sleep here tonight!

You first rinsed off briefly in the shower area, then took a long soak in the large bathtub.

The moment you sank into the hot water, you sighed in relief, as if even the fatigue in your pores had washed away.

After your bath, you explored all the free areas like a child.

You spent a long time watching action movies in the rest area, then headed to the gym to lift weights.

Seeing you effortlessly lift the barbells, several other burly young men took an interest in you and surrounded you, asking you to “compete.”

You felt a familiar feeling of being “called upon” in the military and happily agreed to the upcoming competition.

You took off your bathrobe, shirtless, and began lifting weights.

You began to gradually increase the weight of the barbell, drawing more and more people to watch you.

When you reached the fifth level, the guys competing with you began to feel exhausted. You grabbed the barbell, which had been added to the fifth level, and performed a few squats with perfect form.

You won the competition. Although you didn’t win any prizes, you were still very happy.

The onlookers began to take interest in your muscles, asking you which gym you trained at or where you maintained your fitness.

You told them you weren’t a trainer, just a courier…

“So I’m a laborer. No wonder you’re so strong,” you heard one of the guys who lost say.

“You must carry a lot of goods every day, right?”

“I used to be a soldier…”

The second half of your sentence was choked by the scornful look from the other guy.

Looking at the “surprised” looks from people around you at the answer you gave, you suddenly lost interest in the game.

You grabbed your bathrobe, draped it casually, and left the gym.

You were a little tired from lifting weights, so you returned to the bathtub for a soak to loosen up your tense muscles. Then, standing up again, you decided to head to the lounge area for a nap and some relaxation.

You arrived at the lounge area and checked the time on the wall clock. It was already 8:30.

Lying back on the recliner, you hoped the old man watching TV next door would wake you at 9:15. After receiving a positive response, you slowly closed your eyes.

A short while later, someone shook you awake. You thought it was the old man calling you to get up, but instead, you found a skinny young man squatting stealthily in front of your recliner.

“What’s up?”

You frowned, turned around, and saw that the old man who had just promised to wake you was gone.

“Sir, our place is so luxurious, with such a comprehensive service, and you’re really missing out by not enjoying any of the packages! I think you’d be a bit lonely coming here alone; would you like to…”

The young man looked at you with a slightly lewd smile.

“A Dabaojian?”

Author’s Comment: You looked at the street, just lit up, and didn’t know where to go or who to talk to. The cat litter girl: … The clothes girl: … Today’s option: Wow, the legendary XXX, you need to meet him! As an upright man like you, absolutely refuse!

CONTENT END 45

chapters.title: The Undeliverable Package (Part 5)
chapters.content:
As a “treasure boy” who had been stationed in the army since joining the army and rarely left the house, it’s only natural that you didn’t know what the legendary Dabaojian was.

Maybe you’d heard of it, but you’d never given it much thought.

So your first reaction was that this person was trying to scam you out of money.

“What kind of health care?”

You asked, frowning. “Are you also selling health supplements here?”

The sleazy man was stunned for a moment, then quickly replied, “No, it’s just a health care service that makes you feel relaxed and refreshed…”

He gestured excitedly.

“Really, it’s very comfortable!”

You suddenly remembered that at the bathhouse, there were people helping with back scrubbing, and there were even essential oil back massages!

In the army, when your teammates were trained so hard they couldn’t even lift their hands, they would help each other scrub their backs and apply safflower oil and other massage oils.

You just lifted weights, and you thought a back massage would be more comfortable. So, after a brief hesitation, you asked, “I’m here to see for myself,” with the attitude of “I’m here to see for myself.”

“Okay? How much does a massage cost?”

The sleazy man, seeing your interest, happily answered.

“That depends on what your standard is. We have prices ranging from three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, and one thousand!”

You almost jumped at the price.

“What? Three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, and one thousand?” You were incredulous. “I can’t accept that price!”

You’re just kidding! What if the money doesn’t roll over tomorrow and I have less than a thousand in my account? I’ll be broke!

“Then…how much do you want?”

The creepy man was dumbfounded by your stinginess.

“One or two hundred at most. No more! I’ll pay for it myself!”

Who wouldn’t be a fan of ruthless oil? If it weren’t inconvenient to carry him on his back, he wouldn’t even offer one or two hundred!

“Okay, but think about it. One or two hundred isn’t going to be very good quality.”

When he heard you could do it yourself, the creepy man looked at you with an indescribable expression.

“And we only take cash.”

You agreed, and the creepy man invited you to a separate “lounge.”

After a while, a frail, middle-aged masseur entered.

You glanced at his slender arms and legs, frowning in dissatisfaction.

“I’m all flesh and muscle; this one’s too thin! Try someone else!”

The frail masseuse rolled her eyes at you and left.

Another, heavier woman entered.

You grew even more dissatisfied.

“Why another woman? How can a woman’s hands be strong? And a female masseur wouldn’t be convenient for me!”

You pulled your bathrobe over yourself.

“Where’s the man who just brought me in? Tell him to bring a stronger man!”

“You’re so funny!”

The heavier woman burst into laughter at your words, sizing you up as if she were looking at something special. Then she twisted and walked out, yelling the creepy man’s name.

A moment later, the creepy man entered with a grim expression.

“What’s wrong with you?”

He looked at you as if you were a fool. “With such little money, you still want a man, and one who’s strong at that? We don’t offer that kind of health care! We’re a legitimate bathhouse!”

“Didn’t you say it could make people feel relaxed and at ease?”

You laughed out loud.

“How could you possibly feel relaxed and at ease with a skinny-armed, skinny-legged female massage therapist? You can’t massage my muscular body without a hundred pounds of strength in your hands! If you didn’t find it strenuous, I wouldn’t even pay you two hundred yuan!”

“Besides, isn’t this the men’s section? Female massage therapists should be in the women’s section. There’s clearly something wrong with the division of responsibilities here!”

The sleazy man suddenly understood something, felt a headache, and pulled two hundred yuan from his pocket, slapping it in your face.

“Here’s your two hundred yuan. Go away! I don’t have what you want!”

“What’s the point of running a business if you don’t have anyone!”

Seeing his complete lack of professional ethics, you glared at him fiercely.

“It’s fun to tease people, isn’t it?”

The creepy man saw you looking at him and fearfully covered his chest.

“Don’t look at me; I’m not doing business!”

“You’re crazy! You’re wasting your time!”

Why are you trying to attract customers if you’re not doing business?

And you’re still covering your chest—that’s totally unreasonable!

Even if you wanted to hit someone, you wouldn’t be so effeminate as to hit them in the chest with a hammer!

You angrily took back the two hundred yuan, put on your bathrobe, and strode out of the single-person lounge.

After being tricked, you were in a bad mood. Coupled with your previous experience at the gym, you decided to leave this crappy place that didn’t even have a strong male technician.

The advertisement said “luxurious enjoyment”—what a rip-off!

I’ll never come again!

You dressed, carried your dirty clothes, and left the bathhouse, leaving it with a bad review on Dianping.

This service is terrible! ] I was looking for a back massage in the men’s area, and it was all women, not a single strong male! Is this a massage or just a tickle? And they’re charging five hundred or a thousand for that? What a rip!

After leaving your comment, you felt like a chivalrous knight, casually carrying your dirty laundry to find a lottery station.

This “health check” wasted so much of your time that by the time you found a lottery station and walked in, the draw had already been going on for almost half an hour.

It was already past nine o’clock, but the lottery station was packed with people, their faces flushed and their blood boiling.

You squeezed in, baffled, and heard someone shouting.

“Five hundred million! Who the hell would buy one number on a hundred tickets? Every normal lottery player buys multiple bets!”

The middle-aged man, his eyes blazing, stamped his feet and muttered things you couldn’t understand, like “There must be some insider information” and “We’re just leeks.”

“I just don’t believe it! Unless the person who won 100 tickets has the guts to come out and claim the lottery ticket! I want to see what kind of person could win 500 million!”

Someone won 500 million?

You get it.

Wait…

500 million? ???

You gasped at the number.

‘Wouldn’t a normal person buy 100 tickets with the same number? ‘

Having never bought a lottery ticket before, you were confused, yet you couldn’t hide your excitement.

Whatever? If someone won, you can win too!

Tomorrow it’s your turn to buy 100 tickets!

You quickly approached the owner sitting in front of the TV and asked, “Which one won? Which one?”

The owner pointed to a set of numbers on the blackboard and kindly reminded you that the lottery had already been drawn, so the numbers were useless. There was no way two identical numbers would win.

But you still borrowed a pen and paper and wrote the numbers down on your palm.

You weren’t a good student at school, and numbers weren’t particularly appealing to you, so on the way home, you memorized the numbers all the way home, even more diligently than you’d memorized a text in class.

Please repeat this tomorrow! ]

You returned to your rented basement, thinking this to yourself as you silently repeated the numbers before closing your eyes.

Your day was over.

》》》

A new day.

You opened your eyes, and the first thing you did was reach for your phone.

The time indicated it wasn’t a “new day,” but an “old day.”

The balance in your Alipay account and the sticky feeling on your body also told you it was still “the old day.”

But for the first time, you felt this happy.

“Hahaha, I’m almost going to have 500 million!”

The thought of the numbers you memorized last night made you leap out of bed, jumping around like a madman.

“Five hundred million! Ouch! Five hundred million!”

“Ouch!”

Excessive joy begets sorrow. You’re bouncing and jumping until the bed finally gives way with a creaky creak.

You pull your foot from the sunken cot and look at the large piece of skin scraped off. The pain dampens your ecstasy.

You can’t find your newly bought workout clothes or shoes in your makeshift wardrobe. Only then do you remember that time has regressed again, and you’re now left with only your uniform.

With a sigh, you resignedly put your uniform back on and head out to buy lottery tickets.

You woke up too early; the sky was just beginning to brighten, and the lottery station wasn’t even open yet.

Anyway, you’ll soon have five hundred million. You check your stomach and head to the famous Hong Kong-style restaurant, T’ang Court, to try their legendary “morning tea.”

You ordered a table full of “prawn dumplings,” “barbecued pork buns,” “steamed chicken feet,” “steamed pork ribs,” and “steamed rice rolls,” happily devouring them without paying attention to the surprised looks from the crowd.

You ate until your back was almost broken, and you’d only managed to eat a dozen or so dim sum dishes, and they weren’t even finished yet.

You looked at the menu with regret at the more than forty dim sum items, deciding to try a little every day until you’d tried all forty-three.

When it came time to pay the bill, you felt a pang of pain, but then the thought of your impending five hundred million yuan made the pain disappear. You happily paid the bill and asked the waiter to pack up the remaining dim sum for you.

It was already 8:30, but the lottery shop hadn’t opened yet, so you took the dim sum and headed to the sales office.

You were already late. You saw your colleague, Old Wang, still at the door. But this time, instead of squatting and hesitating, he was remotely directing his daughter to apply to Tsinghua University, having read online that Peking University had rejected a student from a poor county.

“Go to Tsinghua; the school spirit is great!”

You heard Old Wang say seriously, “Our family isn’t well-off, and I’m worried you’ll be discriminated against!”

Old Wang’s tone didn’t sound joking. You rubbed your chin, feeling impressed that Old Wang actually had a daughter who was a top student.

Arriving at the sales location, as expected, you were scolded by both your boss and the cold-faced team leader for being late on your first day.

Thinking you’d soon reach 500 million, you weren’t upset or angry at the scolding. Instead, you smiled and accepted it all, even offering them the snacks you’d brought from that incredibly expensive “Tangge” (a Chinese restaurant).

Seeing the Tangge takeout bags and the expensive snacks you’d bought, the boss and the cold-faced team leader felt embarrassed to scold you further. As a token of their gratitude, they assigned you an extra 50 pieces, and you happily went to eat your snacks.

You were a little upset about the extra 50 deliveries.

But then you thought you’d have 500 million that evening, and you cheered up again. After all, if you couldn’t complete the tasks, the fine wouldn’t be that much.

No, you’re almost 500 million; why are you still working?

You drove your delivery truck full of energy straight to the lottery booth. This time, you forgot about the homeless elderly man on the street, as the direction to the booth didn’t pass him, and you were completely focused on buying lottery tickets.

You excitedly rushed into the already-open booth and bought 99 tickets with the numbers you’d memorized, spending nearly two hundred yuan.

The owner of the lottery booth advised you against such purchases, saying your money would be wasted, but you persisted, spending the two hundred yuan and carefully storing the ticket.

After leaving the booth, you briefly considered slacking off, but your inherent sense of responsibility prevailed, and your common sense prevailed.

You believed that a day’s work meant a day’s work.

So, outside the booth, you drove the delivery truck, looking at the fifty extra packages of the day with a sense of curiosity.

These fifty packages were your driver’s deliveries for the morning, and they overlapped with your own delivery area. Since delivering to the same destination every day would be boring, you decided to prioritize the packages you hadn’t delivered before.

With the dream of reaching 500 million yuan, you continued delivering packages.

After delivering about 30 packages, you called the owner of one package as usual.

A woman answered the phone and told you she was on a business trip, but someone was home and hoped you could deliver the package to her.

You glanced at the address on the third floor and agreed without hesitation, but then she made another request.

It turned out the woman who delivered the package was often away on business. She suspected her husband of infidelity, often taking advantage of the situation to bring women home overnight, but she couldn’t find any evidence.

She hoped you could check to see if there was any woman at her house when you delivered the package, and if so, secretly take a photo of her.

She didn’t want to divorce and give money to such a scumbag.

She said she would thank you generously.

As a man about to reach 500 million yuan, you certainly wouldn’t be tempted by the “large sum of money.” You simply felt it was a pity that a relationship had reached this point.

The woman on the other end of the phone spoke in a mournful tone, pleading with you, and you began to hesitate. Did they take photos for her to review, or did they just deliver the package and not do anything else?

Author’s Comment: Mini-Theatre: The service at this place is terrible! I was in the men’s section looking for a back massage, and it was all women, not a single strong male massage therapist! Is this a massage or just a tickle? And they dared to charge five hundred or a thousand for that? What a rip-off! ] That night, he was surrounded by people watching him, and received thousands of likes: Hahaha, everyone, come and see this idiot! Local police: (Praise) Thank you for this veiled tip. We’ve accepted the public’s report, investigated the location, and seized illegal operations (&&&^%^%#@@… You tilted your head, a thought slowly forming in your mind: …? Announcement of yesterday’s vote: “I’ll see,” 210 points “I’ll reject,” 204 points

CONTENT END 46

chapters.title: The Undeliverable Package (Part 6)
chapters.content:
You’ve never cared about other people’s affairs since you were a child. In the army, you didn’t care about what other people were doing. Now that you’ve entered society, you don’t really want to get involved in such matters.

So you told the woman on the phone that you didn’t need a large sum of money. I’ll take a look at the package when I deliver it, and I’ll just take a picture. You felt that this was intruding on someone’s privacy, which was not good, so you advised her to find a professional.

The owner of the package was disappointed when she heard that you couldn’t take pictures. She said she was a long-distance train attendant, with a busy job and a small social circle. I don’t know how to find a private investigator, but thank you anyway.

You sensed she was a reasonable person, and perhaps she’d come to you for help out of sheer desperation.

With this feeling, you knocked on her door, clutching the package.

A refined, bespectacled man opened the door with a touch of regret. But when he saw the uniform you were wearing, his confusion turned to understanding.

“Whose package is this?”

He naturally reached out to take it.

You told him the owner’s name and asked him to sign for you.

Just then, you heard footsteps from the bedroom. Looking up, you saw… It wasn’t a woman who came out, but a young man.

“It’s a man! So the hostess’s suspicions were just unnecessary. Great!”

You thought to yourself.

The man with glasses didn’t rush to sign but opened the package right in front of you.

“It’s her birthday present. Before she left, she told me to open it in front of her before signing to avoid damaging it.”

He opened the box right in front of you, revealing the latest iPhone.

“Wow, that woman is pretty nice to you. It’s an XS, 256GB, right? That’s nearly ten thousand now, right?”

The young man squeezed over, resting his chin on the man with glasses’ shoulder. He reached out and took the phone out of the box, saying enviously, “That’s great! I want a new phone, too.”

You think there’s something a little strange about this guy, but you can’t put your finger on it.

“I’ll buy you one later. This one was a gift from her, so I can’t give it to you.”

The man with glasses smiled and pinched his nose. He signed the form and handed you the bill.

He was quite polite to you, nodding in warning.

“I checked; it’s fine. Sorry for the trouble.”

You could tell he was subtly urging you to leave, so you took the order and turned to leave.

The man probably assumed you’d close the door like most delivery drivers, so he didn’t notice you left it open.

“How long are you going to keep playing that woman? Didn’t you say you’d get a divorce after fooling your parents?”

You faintly heard the young man complain.

“Tiantian and I are like thieves, and we have to wait until she starts work before we can get together!”

“Isn’t that good? She’s gone for days after work anyway, and we’re apart for a month. What difference does it make whether we get a divorce or not?”

Your feeling of unease grew stronger, and your intuition prompted you to pull out your phone. As you closed the door, you quietly held it up inside and took a blind photo.

After the photo was taken, you saw that it had indeed captured a figure, and your heart pounded.

You gently closed the door and ran downstairs as if fleeing.

This was your first time doing something like this, and you felt like a thief, your heart racing for a long time.

You rode the delivery truck a long way before you called the other person.

“How was it?”

The woman on the other end of the line asked you, with a mixture of anticipation and hesitation.

“There’s no woman in your house,” you replied.

“But there’s a young man.”

The woman was silent for a long time.

“Did you take the photo?”

She whispered, “If so, can I add you on WeChat? I can show you my ID. My home address is where you deliver the package. My parents bought me this house when I was in school. I’m not a strange person.”

You didn’t hesitate and added her on WeChat.

At this moment, you pulled out the secretly taken photos from your phone and prepared to send them to her.

Seeing the blurry figure in the photo, you were stunned.

You were too nervous to notice it just now, but now you see the whole picture.

That elegant man and the young man were hugging each other in the usual way couples do?!

A strange hypothesis popped up in your mind, but with your simple personality and private life, you didn’t dare to think too much about it.

After checking the photo and address on the other person’s ID card and confirming that the woman asking for help was the heroine in the wedding photos in the living room, you sighed and sent her the hugging photo.

[No wonder I can’t find any long hair or any trace of a woman in my house.]

You watched her type out the words one by one.

[But every time I come home, my personal belongings have been touched, and I often find the sheets changed.]

And my husband, even after five months of marriage and a blind date, hasn’t been intimate with me. You were shocked beyond words, and your reserved nature made it difficult to find the words to comfort her.

I had considered asking someone I knew for help, but I was afraid this would get out and I would become a laughingstock. I didn’t start dating and get married until I was thirty. Everyone thought I’d finally found a good home, but only I knew how painful it was. But I couldn’t ignore the opinions of others, and I didn’t dare follow my heart. Thank you for your help and for giving me the courage to pursue the truth.

Even without your response, the woman continued to type.

You realized she wasn’t confiding in you but simply looking for someone to vent her frustrations.

So you just watched quietly, offering no words of comfort.

Don’t worry, if you’re willing to help me, I won’t implicate you. After I learn the truth, I’ll secretly install a camera in my house to collect evidence, but I won’t use this photo as evidence. Just delete my friend list and call history later. Just pretend I never contacted you, and I’ll handle this myself.

“Okay, I hope you succeed. Good luck!”

You clumsily typed these words.

Delivery man, you’re a good person. If this can be resolved satisfactorily, I hope one day I can add you back as a friend and we can be friends. Goodbye.]

She made one last comment and deleted you.

You erased all traces of your contact, grateful for her thoughtfulness in protecting your privacy and admiring her fortitude in taking decisive action.

But at the same time, you couldn’t understand why such a strong and independent woman would have to face such a situation.

Could it be that people’s opinions were so terrifying that even such a strong woman couldn’t escape the shackles of the world?

Five months of marriage without intimacy was enough to prove a lot. Why did she have to resort to this kind of situation, using an outsider to wake herself up?

After a long sigh, you lamented the love you never had, putting aside all the joys and sorrows and continuing to drive your delivery truck to deliver the fifty extra packages.

It turns out that your driver hadn’t separated the packages when he assigned them to you. They were distributed in all directions, east, west, south, and north. By the time you finished delivering them, it was already time to return to the delivery point to pick up the afternoon’s package.

You trudged back to the delivery point, grabbed a quick bite at the office, and started loading new packages.

The unsteady pace of work and the lottery ticket in your arms made you forget everything. It wasn’t until you pulled the heavy bag of cat litter from the sorting pile that you remembered what you had forgotten!

Looking at the time on the wall clock, you didn’t even have time to load the remaining packages. You hurriedly drove your truck to the neighborhood where “Qin Rourou” lived.

You heard your driver chasing you, calling you back, telling you that there were still a lot of packages you hadn’t picked up, but there was no time to turn back, so you could only yell at him.

“I’ll come back to get it later!”

No matter how important the delivery is, it’s not as important as the little girl’s safety!

Your delivery truck has a 40 mph speed limit, so you can’t go any faster. In your haste, you run through several red lights and nearly hit several pedestrians before finally reaching the neighborhood.

In your haste, you don’t even bother to lock your truck. You rush upstairs, carrying the cat litter, and start calling the owner, Qin Rourou.

No one answers, and you don’t hear the phone ringing from the other side of the room.

It’s past the time you’ve previously delivered the cat litter, and you’re worried that the girl with the cat litter has met with something bad at home.

After knocking several times without response, you panic and knock on the door of the girl’s next-door neighbor.

The man opens the door, assuming it’s a package from his son. When you tell him something might have happened next door, he looks at you suspiciously.

“I don’t see anyone suspicious?”

He asked, frowning. “Could it be that the owner is just not home?”

He wasn’t happy to let you use his balcony to visit someone else’s house, and he thought you looked suspicious, warning you he’d call the police if you didn’t leave.

You were frantic, feeling like you couldn’t explain this, so you pushed past him and headed inside.

You’d been to the old man’s house once before and headed straight for his balcony.

The old man was terrified and didn’t dare follow you. Instead, he left his own house, closed the door, and called 110.

You heard the door slam behind you, but you didn’t care anymore.

You figured if anything happened to the girl, it would be your fault for forgetting this important thing!

You ran to the balcony, climbed onto the old man’s terrace, and, fighting the dizziness of the height, jumped toward the window of the girl’s house across the street.

You made the jump. But in your haste, you landed unsteadily, stumbling forward and falling directly onto someone else’s balcony.

Ignoring the pain in your ankle, you limped into the house.

This time, the girl’s room hadn’t been ransacked by the criminals. The pale yellow and tender green furnishings created a warm and cozy atmosphere.

A pure white wool rug lay at the junction of the living room and balcony, bathed in sunlight and looking particularly warm. But as you entered from the balcony, you weren’t paying attention and stepped on it, leaving two large, dark footprints on the carpet.

You turned and looked around but didn’t see the criminal or the girl you’d subdued last time. Worried she’d been killed, you called out “Qin Rourou” as you headed for the only bedroom with a door.

Your noises were so loud that they finally alerted the person inside. As you watched with a wary expression, the bedroom door slowly opened…

A disheveled woman in a nightgown emerged.

Your eyes met, startled. Qin Rourou, clearly jolted awake from a nap, screamed.

You realized this time it might not be the AC contractor who had come to your house to “commit a crime.” Perhaps the person didn’t answer your call because they were simply sound asleep and their phone was turned off or on silent.

After figuring out what had happened, you were startled by her scream and realized belatedly that you had committed trespassing.

“I’m not a bad person! I’m the deliveryman delivering cat litter!”

Your expression grew horrified, and you tried to comfort the frightened girl.

“What cat litter?”

After hearing your explanation, the girl stopped screaming and looked at you suspiciously.

“Why would you come from the balcony to deliver cat litter?”

He seemed quite bold and curious. You stared at her, unsure how to explain your actions.

Should I tell her everything that happened to her, hoping she’d believe it…?

Or should I just express my concerns, trying to convince her it was all a good-natured misunderstanding?

CONTENT END 47

chapters.title: The Undelivered Package (Part 7)
chapters.content:
Frustrated by her questioning, you desperately tried to convince her you were simply worried about her safety.

But you, such a dull guy, definitely don’t have the skill of “smooth talk.” With your tongue so clumsy, how could you possibly lie?!

So you mumbled “hmm” for a long time, then, facing her increasingly questioning expression, you gritted your teeth and decided to tell her everything about the strange things that had happened to you.

At least this was something that had actually happened, so you couldn’t stumble over your explanation.

Thankfully, you didn’t repeat yourself many times, so it didn’t take long for you to finish the story.

After finishing this completely unexciting “story” dryly, your heart sank coldly, and you resignedly waited for the moment when you would be considered a psychopath. You weren’t considered a psychopath, but you weren’t much better off either.

“You said you were repeating the same routine every day, and you’re still delivering packages every day?”

The cat litter girl looked at you like you were an idiot, her expression odd. “Every day? Keep delivering?”

You didn’t know what she was wondering, so you nodded obediently.

“Yes, I’ll keep delivering every day.”

“Do you think I can believe what you said?”

The cat litter girl seemed to laugh out loud, looking at her with a sidelong glance.

You weren’t frightened but rather scratched your ear in embarrassment.

Even though the girl looked incredibly imposing, her sweet, innocent voice didn’t sound aggressive at all; it seemed more like she was just being coquettish.

You knew this was wrong, so you sincerely confirmed, “Really? I really do deliver packages every day. Only one afternoon did I take time out to buy some clothes and take a shower…”

“Don’t you think that’s ridiculous? Even if you could repeat this every day, wouldn’t you do something meaningful with it? Delivering packages, buying clothes, taking a shower—do you think a normal person would do that?”

The cat litter girl doesn’t want to waste any more time with you. “Please get out right now, or I’ll call the police!”

“It’s all true! I never came this early before. The first time, I was delivering other packages before I arrived. Later, I just happened to run into this guy. Today, I was afraid of losing time, so I sped all the way here…”

You start analyzing why you made such a mistake, concluding that your overly concerned nature made you arrive too early.

If she’d been a little later, she’d have just finished her nap and would have been there for your call.

As you spoke, there was a knock on the girl’s door.

“You just said the neighbor next door called the police. Could it be the police?”

The girl in her nightgown pulled her robe up uncomfortably. “Then please go out and explain your ‘circularity theory’ to the police yourself.”

Knowing it’s hard to gain his trust, you can only smile wryly as you open the door, bracing for your impending capture.

Then the door opens, revealing the air conditioner repairman, slinging a rope and tools.

The moment the door opened, he subconsciously glanced inside, like any suspicious person with ill intentions always looking for an opportunity to take advantage.

When he saw it was you, he unexpectedly withdrew his gaze and forced a smile that only befitted an honest man.

“No, sorry, I’m here to fix the air conditioner. Building 4, please…”

“I know what you do, and I know who you are. I advise you not to think about anything else besides fixing air conditioners.”

You changed your previous pitiful and helpless expression, your glare as sharp as a sword, and your aura imposing.

“You’ve been in prison for so many years and have just been released. You should cherish your chance to start a new life. Did the state let you learn electrical work and appliance repair in prison so you could use them to commit crimes upon your release? It’s so you can re-enter society and live a ‘human life’!”

You unconsciously stood at attention, berating the person in front of you with the same vigor you’d used when a squad leader was training new recruits: “Just fix the air conditioner. Don’t look upstairs or downstairs. Do you think no one’s watching you now that you’re out? Room 402 is downstairs, and this is room 502!”

“If you want to go back in, I’ll help you!”

The air conditioner worker hadn’t expected his background to be exposed so clearly, and even his hidden thoughts were exposed, shaking him like a sieve sifting flour.

“So, so, someone really is following us when we get out?”

At the sight of your impeccable military posture, he paled with fear, trembling, “Leader, comrade, I was just thinking! Seriously, I didn’t do anything!”

He mistook you for a plainclothes officer in disguise, or perhaps a member of the armed police.

“But this is too cunning, disguised as a courier!”

Thinking of the delivery truck he had just seen downstairs, he cried out in despair.

After spending so long in prison, the air conditioner worker had become somewhat disconnected from society.

At this moment, he feared that even the call to fix the air conditioner was a test from the “state,” and in a daze, he suddenly poured out all his thoughts.

“I haven’t had a woman in ages, and the thought is just too painful! I know I’m sick, and I’ll find a cure. If that doesn’t work, I’ll just find a proper wife and live my life! I’ve been possessed by a demon this time, and I’ll never do anything bad again. I promise! I swear! You can watch me!”

He swore to the heavens, then bowed his head and stamped his feet. He repeatedly looked back toward the aisle in fear, fearing a group of uniformed officers would burst out from there and take him away again.

“You said it yourself, you want to clean up your act and turn over a new leaf. You’d better not take any chances. Otherwise, you’ll be back in jail in a second!”

You’re just an ordinary courier, not a real police officer. After threatening him harshly, you slammed the door.

The air conditioner worker ran away in terror.

After this incident, he felt like countless eyes were watching him from behind, so he couldn’t even think about “fixing the air conditioner.” He stumbled downstairs from his apartment building. Before he even reached the gate, he saw a police car pull up and two or three uniformed officers get out.

Someone was watching him!

He’d been out of prison for over six months, and he hadn’t done anything in that time!

The air conditioner worker, terrified, turned and ran, climbing over the wall out the back door of the complex.

》》》

You scared off the unsuspecting air conditioner worker with your aggressive tone. Turning around, you saw a young woman looking at you with a half-belief.

“Could this really happen?”

The young woman shuddered at the thought of what you’d just said happened to her.

“You didn’t conspire to get someone to scam me, did you?”

“Why would I hire someone to scam you?”

You wiped your face helplessly. “First, he broke in, then tricked him into going to the police station?”

Glancing at the wall clock, it was almost two o’clock, and something suddenly occurred to you.

“I remember, on my first day at work, I think I saw a news story on the big TV outside a shopping mall. It said a bus had collided with a tanker truck on East Jiang Road. It must have been a serious accident…”

You had no more convincing information. “If I remember correctly, it was exactly two o’clock when the news came on…”

The young woman paused for a moment, then went back to her bedroom, pulled out her phone, and began checking.

She was already 80% convinced by your words.

After all, no burglar or thief would, upon being caught, not bolt out or take advantage of the situation to do something else, but instead tell you such an outrageous story in the living room in a friendly and amiable manner.

And it just so happened that the “air conditioner worker” in his story who had just been released from prison came knocking on your door.

At that moment, there was another knock on the young lady’s door. Thinking the air conditioner worker had returned, you opened it with a stern look on your face.

“Didn’t I tell you…”

Looking at the worried elderly neighbor and several police officers who had followed you outside, you were stunned, your words stumbling.

“What’s going on? We got a report that you broke into someone’s house and jumped from the balcony into this one?”

Seeing your furious expression, the investigating police instinctively reached for the handcuffs at their waist. “Do you know that trespassing is illegal?!”

Perhaps they had never seen such an arrogant suspect. Seeing that he hadn’t fled even after the police were called and was still brazenly lingering in the victim’s home, the officers’ faces turned grim.

“I…”

You knew you were going to waste the day, and with regret for the lottery ticket in your arms, you prepared to confess your mistake to the police.

“He’s my boyfriend. I had a fight with him yesterday and haven’t answered his calls since…”

Suddenly, a young woman came over and helped you explain to the police.

“He was afraid I’d be upset at home, afraid something might happen to me, so he did something stupid!”

Everyone was stunned, including you.

“No, I…”

You were lost for words and about to explain when the young woman glared at you.

“What are you talking about? You shouldn’t have done that! Even if you were in a hurry, you couldn’t have done that! You even alerted the police officer. It’s so embarrassing!”

The young woman slapped you across the face, cutting off your words.

After hearing the young woman’s explanation, the situation began to make sense. The old neighbor breathed a sigh of relief, a smile returning to his face. “So it was just a misunderstanding, that’s all. I’d never met this guy before, and I didn’t know he was your boyfriend. I called the police when I saw him barging into my house…”

“I’m sorry, I’m so sorry. He’s just too single-minded and worried about me. It’s also my fault. I was so sound asleep I didn’t hear the call!”

The young woman was still in her nightgown, lending her words even more credibility.

“I just scolded him!”

“What’s with that big bag by the door?”

An officer asked about a large bag of cat litter left by the entrance.

“Meow, meow, meow…”

The cat, with its graceful little steps, emerged from the bedroom and came to the rescue.

“That’s cat litter.”

You said in a muffled voice.

“Oh, my boyfriend’s a delivery guy, so I asked him to carry the cat litter upstairs for me. It’s over 20 pounds—too heavy! I just can’t lift it.”

The young woman reacted quickly, remembering the story he’d told her about how he’d saved her.

“You know, over 20 pounds is a lot!”

You grumbled inwardly.

“Then why did the neighbor say they hadn’t seen you before? Didn’t you use cat litter before?”

The officer poked at every inconsistency.

“Today is my first day on the job.”

Realizing the young woman was protecting you, you pulled your work ID from around your neck. “I’m in charge of her district now, so bringing it upstairs is just a side job.”

“I understand. Finding an excuse to come over to your girlfriend’s house to please her. I used to do that when I was younger.”

The old man smiled and smoothed things over.

The police needed to see your ID. You handed over your ID, military discharge certificate, and work permit. The officers checked your identity and found you innocent. All your identification was verified, and they returned your documents.

After gaining the forgiveness of both the old man and the young woman, the officer sternly reprimanded you and warned you not to do such a dangerous thing again.

After sincerely accepting the criticism and admonishment, you dejectedly sent the officer away, feeling incredibly guilty for wasting precious police resources.

But then you thought, at least no one was hurt, and your heart brightened again.

“Thank you for helping me.”

You thought she was such a kind person. “It’s so ridiculous, I can’t believe it myself…”

“Take a look at this first.”

The young woman pulled out her phone, switched to the page she was looking at, and held it in front of you.

At 1:45 p.m., a bus and a tanker truck collided, and the truck burst into flames and exploded.

According to eyewitnesses passing by the scene, there appears to have been an argument inside the car before the accident, distracting the driver and causing the accident.

However, because the surveillance footage is completely destroyed and there’s no direct evidence, this account can’t be supported by facts and can only be considered speculation.

“If you didn’t actually experience all this, then it can only mean…”

The young woman looked at you coldly.

“You and the person who distracted the driver might be in cahoots.”

“I’m not. I don’t know about anyone on the bus…”

The young woman’s expression was so serious and cold that you blanched at her baseless speculation.

“Yes, I don’t think it’s likely either.”

The young woman, whose expression had been stern just moments before, suddenly laughed.

“So, we can only believe what you’re saying is true!”

It was a joke, but it wasn’t funny at all.

You were terrified, sweating profusely, and all you wanted to do was get out of here.
